papers.title: What Survives a Change of Quantum Reference Frame? Coherence Thresholds for the Spectral, Holonomic, and Topological Content of Mixed-State Quantum Geometry
papers.abstract: A reduced density matrix conditioned on an internal quantum reference frame (QRF) carries, through its mixed-state quantum geometric tensor, a Fisher–Bures metric and an Uhlmann gauge field. We determine which parts of this structure are frame-independent, separating passive frame changes (reparametrizations and observer-local unitaries) from active ones (a change in the internal frame itself) within the perspective-neutral framework. Under passive changes, the spectrum and the eigenbundle Chern numbers are invariant for every smooth single-valued transformation, and the metric and the Uhlmann holonomy only for reparametrizations and constant unitaries. Under an active change between ideal frames of a compact group, the observer’s marginal obeys an exact orientation-conditioned law for every relational state, and its group-twirled part is frame-invariant; for abelian frames, this is a shifted-overlap law whose invariant part is the charge distribution, which gives the entanglement-plus-coherence invariant of Cepollaro et al. in closed form. For a product relative state, the law reduces to the known partial twirl (relativization) by the relative-orientation density of the two frames, identified here with the relational state of the new frame, under which the metric can only contract. For a two-level observer and an abelian frame, the geometry is then graded by one inter-frame coherence |κ|: the Bures area is π|κ|, the Chern numbers survive for every |κ|>0, and the equatorial Uhlmann Z2 holonomy survives only for |κ|>3/2, the known thermal critical point of the spin-12 Uhlmann phase reached here by coherence instead of temperature. No threshold classification is claimed for non-abelian frames or correlated relational states. For bounded generators, the observer’s definability is itself frame-relative.
papers.abstract_zh: 以内部量子参考系（QRF）为条件的约化密度矩阵，通过其混合态量子几何张量，携带Fisher–Bures度量和Uhlmann规范场。我们在透视中性框架内确定该结构中哪些部分与参考系无关，将被动参考系变化（重参数化和观测者局部酉变换）与主动变化（内部参考系本身的改变）区分开来。在被动变化下，对于每个光滑单值变换，谱和本征丛Chern数是不变的；而度量和Uhlmann完整群仅对重参数化和常数酉变换不变。在紧群理想参考系之间的主动变化下，对于每个关系态，观测者的边缘态服从精确的取向条件定律，其群扭曲部分与参考系无关；对于阿贝尔参考系，这是一个平移重叠定律，其不变部分是电荷分布，它以闭形式给出Cepollaro等人的纠缠加相干不变量。对于乘积相对态，该定律约化为由两个参考系的相对取向密度所给出的已知部分扭曲（相对化），此处将其等同于新参考系的关系态，在该关系态下度量只能收缩。对于两能级观测者和阿贝尔参考系，几何随后由一个帧间相干性|κ|分级：Bures面积为π|κ|，Chern数对每个|κ|>0均存活，而赤道Uhlmann Z2完整群仅对|κ|>3/2存活，这是自旋-12 Uhlmann相的已知热临界点，此处通过相干性而非温度达到。对于非阿贝尔参考系或相关关系态，不声称有阈值分类。对于有界生成元，观测者的可定义性本身是参考系相对的。

papers.title: Verifiable quantum advantage via optimized DQI circuits
Variational quantum transduction
papers.abstract: Quantum transducers are critical for quantum interconnect, enabling coherent signal transfer across disparate frequency domains. Beyond material and device advances, protocol design has become a powerful means to improve transduction. We introduce a variational quantum transduction (VQT) framework that employs variational tools from near-term quantum computing to systematically optimize protocol performance. As a variational quantum circuit, the existence of barren plateau does not prevent VQT from providing substantial advantage, as a small-scale problem is sufficient for quantum transduction and training only needs to be done once to configure a VQT system. Maximizing the quantum information rate within this framework yields protocols that surpass the benchmark schemes considered in their respective classes within the finite-energy regimes under consideration. For non-adaptive protocols, VQT exceeds the performance envelopes of Gottesman–Kitaev–Preskill-based and entanglement-assisted approaches. In the adaptive setting, VQT provides only a marginal improvement over Gaussian feedforward strategies, indicating that Gaussian adaptive transduction is already close to optimal for the parameter regimes that we studied. With increasingly universal quantum control, VQT provides a systematic path toward optimized quantum transduction.
papers.abstract_zh: 量子换能器对量子互连至关重要，能够实现跨不同频域之间的相干信号传输。除了材料和器件方面的进展外，协议设计已成为提升换能性能的有力手段。我们提出了一种变分量子换能（VQT）框架，该框架利用近期量子计算中的变分工具来系统优化协议性能。作为一个变分量子电路，贫瘠高原的存在并不妨碍VQT提供显著优势，因为量子换能所需的问题规模较小，且训练只需进行一次即可配置VQT系统。在该框架内最大化量子信息速率所得到的协议，在所考虑的有限能量范围内，超越了各自类别中的基准方案。对于非自适应协议，VQT超越了基于Gottesman–Kitaev–Preskill方法和纠缠辅助方法的性能包络。在自适应设置下，VQT相较于高斯前馈策略仅提供边际改进，这表明在我们所研究的参数范围内，高斯自适应换能已接近最优。随着量子控制日益趋向通用化，VQT为优化量子换能提供了一条系统化的路径。

papers.abstract: Quantum error correction (QEC) is essential for scalable quantum computing, yet existing approaches rely on static assumptions about noise that break down in realistic hardware where error channels drift over time. We introduce a unified framework that separates QEC into two learning timescales: offline code discovery and online adaptation. Offline, multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) autonomously discovers complete QEC cycles as explicit quantum circuits, with separate agents responsible for encoding, syndrome extraction, and error recovery, and without prescribing a code family or circuit ansatz. Online, a lightweight adaptive layer, termed Bandit Retraining for Adaptive Variational Error Correction, realigns the discovered code with the drifting error channel through a transversal single-unit rotation, while a bandit controller decides from the syndrome record when an update is worth its cost. Updates are applied during operation, without decoding the logical state or retraining the MARL stack, and follow drifts on timescales of order 0.1 s and longer. This yields a ‘discover once, adapt online’ strategy that combines the flexibility of learned codes with real-time adaptation to non-stationary noise. At sufficiently high sampling rates relative to noise drift, our method reduces logical infidelity by up to 3.1-fold for qubit codes and 3.4-fold for qutrit codes compared to the strongest static alternative at each error rate, including a perfect code using two more physical units, while substantially extending robustness to noise fluctuations. These results establish a paradigm in which QEC is no longer static but dynamically optimized for realistic quantum hardware.
papers.abstract_zh: 量子纠错（QEC）对于可扩展量子计算至关重要，但现有方法依赖于关于噪声的静态假设，而这些假设在误差通道随时间漂移的真实硬件中会失效。我们引入了一个统一框架，将QEC分为两个学习时间尺度：离线代码发现和在线适应。在离线阶段，多智能体强化学习（MARL）自主发现完整的QEC循环作为显式量子电路，由分别负责编码、综合征提取和错误恢复的独立智能体组成，且不预设代码族或电路拟设。在在线阶段，一个轻量级自适应层——称为用于自适应变分纠错的Bandit再训练——通过横向单单元旋转使已发现的代码与漂移的误差通道重新对齐，同时一个Bandit控制器根据综合征记录决定何时更新值得其成本。更新在运行期间应用，无需解码逻辑状态或重新训练MARL栈，并跟踪量级为0.1秒及更长时间的漂移。这产生了一种“一次发现、在线适应”的策略，将学习代码的灵活性与对非平稳噪声的实时适应相结合。在相对于噪声漂移足够高的采样率下，与每个错误率下最强的静态替代方案（包括使用多两个物理单元的完美代码）相比，我们的方法将逻辑不保真度最多降低3.1倍（量子比特代码）和3.4倍（量子三态代码），同时大幅扩展了对噪声波动的鲁棒性。这些结果建立了一种范式，其中QEC不再是静态的，而是针对真实量子硬件进行动态优化。

papers.title: Quantum telescopy with realistic anticorrelated optical fields as references
papers.abstract: First proposed by Gottesman . [], the quantum telescopic technique uses spatially entangled single-photon states as references to modify the traditional Hanbury Brown–Twiss (HBT) intensity stellar interferometric technique. The technique can rival the Michelson stellar interferometry in signal level but is not restricted by the baseline size, so it has the potential to significantly increase the resolution in astronomical imaging in the optical domain. In practice, single-photon states generated in the laboratory are usually not ideal in that they have finite bandwidth and nonunit efficiency. Furthermore, detectors also have finite response time and celestial light has a bandwidth. All of this will have an impact on the effectiveness of the quantum telescopic technique. In this work, we consider a spatially entangled singe-photon state generated by beam splitting a practical antibunched photon source from resonance fluorescence, which is a common method of generating single-photon states, and evaluate the signal level in quantum telescopy with inclusion of imperfection of detection system and finite bandwidth of celestial light. Here, given the incoming light, we optimize the parameters of the antibunched photon source and the detector system for the best signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), which can match that of the Michelson method in the ideal case but is always smaller in the realistic case. Alternatively, weak coherent states from heavily attenuated lasers can replace the entangled single-photon state but suffer low signal level, similar to the HBT method. We find that the SNR with a realistic antibunched source for producing the reference fields can still beat the SNR of the coherent state scheme in the weak incoming field limit. The optimized parameters for the antibunched source and detection system will be a guide for future experimental endeavor.
papers.abstract_zh: Gottesman首次提出[]，量子望远技术利用空间纠缠的单光子态作为参考，改进传统的汉伯里·布朗–特威斯（HBT）强度恒星干涉测量技术。该技术在信号水平上可与迈克尔逊恒星干涉测量相媲美，但不受基线尺寸的限制，因此在光学域的天文成像中具有显著提高分辨率的潜力。在实践中，实验室产生的单光子态通常不理想，因为它们具有有限带宽和非单位效率。此外，探测器也具有有限响应时间，且天体光具有带宽。所有这些都会对量子望远技术的有效性产生影响。在这项工作中，我们考虑由分束实际反聚束光子源（来自共振荧光，这是一种常见的单光子态产生方法）产生的空间纠缠单光子态，并在包含探测系统不完美性和天体光有限带宽的情况下评估量子望远中的信号水平。在这里，给定入射光，我们优化反聚束光子源和探测器系统的参数以获得最佳信噪比（SNR），该信噪比在理想情况下可与迈克尔逊方法匹配，但在现实情况下总是较小。或者，来自重度衰减激光器的弱相干态可以取代纠缠单光子态，但信号水平低，类似于HBT方法。我们发现，在弱入射场极限下，用于产生参考场的现实反聚束源的SNR仍可胜过相干态方案的SNR。反聚束源和探测系统的优化参数将为未来实验努力提供指导。

papers.abstract: Generating usable output-entanglement in continuous variable systems can serve as a viable resource for improving applications in quantum information science. In this work, we show how to generate steady-state output-entanglement in a two-stage conversion setup between optical and microwave photon which employs resonantly coupled magnetic and mechanical excitations, as proposed in (2022 Phys. Rev. Appl. 18 044059). We show that the entanglement can be maximized for the same set of parameters which optimize the frequency-conversion efficiency, and that it can be leveraged for a teleportation-based state-transfer protocol for coherent input-states with fidelity close to unity. We propose an implementation based on an yttrium iron garnet disk of micrometer scale, and use both simulation results and reasonable estimates to assess the performance under optimized conditions. We find a maximum teleportation fidelity of 0.75 for the proposed setup.
papers.abstract_zh: 在连续变量系统中生成可用的输出纠缠可以作为改善量子信息科学应用的一种可行资源。在本工作中，我们展示了如何在一个光学与微波光子之间的两阶段转换装置中生成稳态输出纠缠，该装置采用共振耦合的磁激发和机械激发，如（2022 Phys. Rev. Appl. 18 044059）所提出。我们表明，对于优化频率转换效率的同一组参数，纠缠可以被最大化，并且它可以被用于一种基于隐形传态的状态转移协议，用于相干输入态，保真度接近1。我们提出了一种基于微米级钇铁石榴石圆盘的实现方案，并使用模拟结果和合理估计来评估优化条件下的性能。我们发现所提出装置的最大隐形传态保真度为0.75。

Measurement circuit ansatz: Naimark versus quantum neural-network measurements
papers.abstract: In this work, we present constructions of quantum circuits to implement general measurements on quantum hardware. Firstly, we investigate a quantum circuit ansatz by following the Naimark extension with a universal set of gates, such as controlled-NOT and single-qubit gates; we call it a Naimark measurement . We present a circuit ansatz framed by the Naimark extension, leaving single-qubit gates with parameters, and apply a classical optimizer to determine their parameters to approximate a desired quantum measurement. Secondly, we relax the Naimark measurement with quantum neural-network (QNN) circuits, employing parameterized quantum circuits. We present hybrid Naimark-QNN measurements by incorporating QNN circuits into Naimark measurements. Thirdly, we also consider fully QNN measurements with shallow parameterized circuits. Then, we compare the constructed measurement circuits, Naimark, hybrid Naimark-QNN, and fully QNN measurements, for strategies of state discrimination, such as minimum-error and maximum-confidence measurements. We demonstrate that QNN circuits can efficiently and effectively achieve near-optimal quantum measurements with fewer training iterations.
papers.abstract_zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了在量子硬件上实现通用测量的量子电路构造。首先，我们研究了一种遵循Naimark扩展的量子电路拟设，使用通用门集，如受控-NOT和单量子比特门；我们称之为Naimark测量。我们提出了一个由Naimark扩展框架的电路拟设，留下带有参数的单量子比特门，并应用经典优化器来确定它们的参数，以近似所需的量子测量。其次，我们用参数化量子电路的量子神经网络（QNN）电路放宽了Naimark测量。我们通过将QNN电路纳入Naimark测量，提出了混合Naimark-QNN测量。第三，我们还考虑了带有浅层参数化电路的完全QNN测量。然后，我们比较了构造的测量电路——Naimark、混合Naimark-QNN和完全QNN测量——用于状态区分策略，如最小误差和最大置信度测量。我们证明了QNN电路能够以更少的训练迭代高效且有效地实现接近最优的量子测量。

papers.abstract: A variety of photon-mediated operations are critical to the realization of scalable quantum information processing platforms and their accurate characterization is essential for the identification of optimal regimes and their experimental realizations. Such light-matter interactions are often studied with a broad variety of analytical and computational methods that are constrained by approximation techniques or by computational scaling. Quantum processors present a new avenue to address these challenges. Here, we develop and implement an algorithm compatible with NISQ (noisy intermediate scale quantum) devices that allows a comprehensive characterization of cavity mediated two-qubit gates over a broad parameter space. In particular, we investigate the underlying quantum state transfer between the qubits, and illustrate its efficiency as a function of the detunings and couplings between the qubits and the cavity, and as a function of the damping factor of the cavity. Our algorithm is validated by a comparison with analytical results where applicable. The algorithm allows us to identify underexplored regimes of optimal performance, from which we report two insightful findings—one where we observe a state transfer fidelity of about 99 % in the intermediate detuning regime, and the other where we observe a significant boost in fidelity with qubits that are moderately detuned from each other by coupling them unequally to a far-detuned cavity. Furthermore, we illustrate the breakdown of the rotating wave approximation as we approach the ultrastrong coupling and the deep-dispersive regimes. While the current paper addresses a system that only involves a few qubits and can be solved using classical numerical methods, the algorithm can be readily extended to study a variety of systems and processes in quantum information processing that employ cavity- or photon-mediated coupling between qubits, particularly larger systems such as many-emitter ensembles, cavity arrays, and multimode cavities, that are classically intractable.
papers.abstract_zh: 多种光子介导的操作对于实现可扩展的量子信息处理平台至关重要，而其精确表征对于确定最佳 regime 及其实验实现必不可少。这类光-物质相互作用通常借助各种解析和计算方法进行研究，但这些方法受限于近似技术或计算规模。量子处理器为应对这些挑战提供了新途径。在此，我们开发并实现了一种与 NISQ（含噪声中等规模量子）设备兼容的算法，该算法能够在广泛的参数空间内对腔介导的双量子比特门进行全面表征。特别地，我们研究了量子比特之间潜在的量子态转移，并展示了其效率随量子比特与腔之间失谐和耦合的变化关系，以及随腔阻尼因子的变化关系。我们的算法通过与适用情况下的解析结果进行比较而得到验证。该算法使我们能够识别出尚未充分探索的最佳性能 regime，由此我们报告了两项有洞见的发现——其一是在中间失谐 regime 中观察到约 99% 的态转移保真度，其二是在将彼此适度失谐的量子比特不等地耦合到远失谐腔时观察到保真度显著提升。此外，我们说明了当接近超强耦合和深色散 regime 时旋转波近似的失效。尽管本文处理的是一个仅涉及少量量子比特、可用经典数值方法求解的系统，但该算法可以很容易地推广到研究量子信息处理中采用腔或光子介导的量子比特间耦合的各种系统和过程，特别是许多发射体集合、腔阵列和多模腔等经典上难以处理的更大系统。

papers.title: Calculating the quantum Fisher information via the truncated Wigner method
Benchmarking Gaussian and Non-Gaussian Input States with a Hybrid Sampling Platform
papers.abstract: The original boson sampling paradigm—consisting of multiple single-photon input states, a large interferometer, and multi-channel click detection—was originally proposed as a photonic route to quantum computational advantage. Its non-Gaussian resources, essential for outperforming any classical system, are provided by single-photon inputs and click detection. Yet the drive toward larger experiments has led to the replacement of experimentally demanding single-photon sources with Gaussian states, thereby diminishing the available non-Gaussianity—a critical quantum resource. As the community broadens its focus from the initial sampling task to possible real-world applications, it becomes crucial to quantify the performance cost associated with reducing non-Gaussian resources and to benchmark sampling platforms that employ different input states. To address this need, we introduce the Paderborn Quantum Sampler (PaQS), a hybrid platform capable of performing sampling experiments with eight Gaussian or non-Gaussian input states in a 12-mode interferometer within a single experimental run. This architecture enables direct, side-by-side benchmarking of distinct sampling regimes under otherwise identical conditions—only the input states vary between configurations. By employing a semi-device-independent framework based on matrix of moments approaches that offers certification that does not rely on prior knowledge of the interferometer or the input states, we verify that the observed data cannot be reproduced using classical resource states—a prerequisite for demonstrating quantum advantage. Applying this framework, we show that non-Gaussian inputs offer a distinct advantage in the verification of nonclassicality under our proposed metric.
papers.abstract_zh: 原始的玻色采样范式——由多个单光子输入态、一个大型干涉仪和多通道点击探测组成——最初是作为实现量子计算优势的光子途径提出的。其非高斯资源对于超越任何经典系统至关重要，由单光子输入和点击探测提供。然而，追求更大实验规模的驱动力导致实验要求苛刻的单光子源被高斯态所取代，从而削弱了可用的非高斯性——一种关键的量子资源。随着学术界关注点从最初的采样任务扩展到可能的实际应用，量化与减少非高斯资源相关的性能成本，并对采用不同输入态的采样平台进行基准测试，变得至关重要。为满足这一需求，我们推出了帕德博恩量子采样器（PaQS），这是一个混合平台，能够在单次实验运行中，在12模式干涉仪中对八个高斯或非高斯输入态执行采样实验。该架构使得在其他条件完全相同的情况下——仅输入态在配置之间变化——能够直接并排地对不同的采样机制进行基准测试。通过采用基于矩矩阵方法的半器件无关框架，该框架提供的认证不依赖于对干涉仪或输入态的预先知识，我们验证了观测数据无法使用经典资源态重现——这是展示量子优势的先决条件。应用该框架，我们表明，在我们提出的度量标准下，非高斯输入在非经典性验证方面提供了明显的优势。

papers.title: Quantum work statistics and coherence effects in quenched bosonic Josephson junctions
papers.abstract: We investigate the non-equilibrium work statistics originating from a sudden quench in a bosonic Josephson junction. In particular, by employing the Holstein–Primakoff approximation, the work statistics are analytically characterized in the weak-interaction regime, where the dynamics map onto a time-dependent quantum harmonic oscillator. For a junction initialized in the ground state of the pre-quench Hamiltonian, we demonstrate that the work statistics are governed by a negative binomial distribution, as occurs in fully-connected models driven across a critical point. Furthermore, we also consider initial superposition states containing quantum coherences in the energy basis. To characterize the corresponding work distributions, we employ Kirkwood–Dirac quasiprobabilities (KDQ). Even in the simplest case, when the junction is initialized in a superposition of the ground and second excited states, the KDQ distribution of work exhibits negative or complex values, reflecting non-classical features. Moreover, the coherence content of the initial state can be optimized to enhance the extractable work achieved by the sudden quench, beyond classical bounds. Finally, we propose an experimental interferometric protocol to directly measure the characteristic function of the work distribution in experimentally accessible settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由突然淬火在玻色约瑟夫森结中产生的非平衡功统计。特别地，通过采用Holstein–Primakoff近似，在弱相互作用区域对功统计进行了分析表征，其中动力学映射到一个含时量子谐振子。对于初始化为淬火前哈密顿量基态的结，我们证明了功统计服从负二项分布，正如在跨越临界点驱动的全连接模型中所发生的那样。此外，我们还考虑了在能量基中具有量子相干性的初始叠加态。为了表征相应的功分布，我们采用了Kirkwood–Dirac准概率（KDQ）。即使在最简单的情况下，当结初始化为基态和第二激发态的叠加时，功的KDQ分布表现出负值或复值，反映了非经典特征。此外，初始态的相干性内容可以被优化，以增强由突然淬火实现的可提取功，超越经典界限。最后，我们提出了一个实验干涉协议，以在实验可及的设置中直接测量功分布的特征函数。

papers.abstract: Quantum signal processing (QSP) and quantum singular value transformation (QSVT) provide an efficient framework for implementing polynomials of block-encoded matrices, and thus offer a systematic approach to quantum algorithm design. However, despite a number of recent advances, important limitations remain. In particular, QSP can only transform unitary matrices, by applying a polynomial to their eigenvalues, while QSVT is a singular value transformation and thus one can only obtain the polynomial of Hermitian matrices. As a consequence, these techniques do not directly apply to an arbitrary non-Hermitian matrix that is not diagonalizable. In this work, we propose a simple yet powerful method to extend these ideas to arbitrary square matrices by acting on their eigenvalues. To this end, we introduce the notion of an n -regular block encoding, namely, a block encoding whose k th power reproduces the k th power of the encoded matrix for every 0 ≤ k ≤ n . We show that applying QSP to any unitary with this property is equivalent to applying a polynomial of degree at most n to the block-encoded matrix, independently of its internal structure. Moreover, we provide a simple construction that transforms any block encoding into an n -regular one using only O ( log n ) ancillary qubits and O ( n log ( n / ε ) ) operations. Finally, we show that this construction induces the desired transformation on the eigenvalues associated with the Jordan normal form of the matrix; for nondiagonalizable matrices, this yields the full matrix function P ( A ) , whose action on each Jordan block involves the derivatives of P , and not merely the map λ ↦ P ( λ ) .
papers.abstract_zh: 量子信号处理（QSP）与量子奇异值变换（QSVT）为实施块编码矩阵的多项式提供了一个高效框架，从而为量子算法设计提供了一种系统方法。然而，尽管近期有许多进展，重要局限性依然存在。特别是，QSP仅能通过将多项式应用于其特征值来变换酉矩阵，而QSVT是一种奇异值变换，因此只能获得厄米矩阵的多项式。 consequently，这些技术不能直接应用于不可对角化的任意非厄米矩阵。在本工作中，我们提出了一种简单而强大的方法，通过作用于任意方阵的特征值将其扩展至这些矩阵。为此，我们引入了n-正则块编码的概念，即一种块编码，其第k次幂对于所有0 ≤ k ≤ n均重现编码矩阵的第k次幂。我们证明，对具有此性质的任何酉矩阵应用QSP等价于对块编码矩阵应用次数最多为n的多项式，无论其内部结构如何。此外，我们提供了一种简单构造，仅使用O(log n)个辅助量子比特和O(n log(n/ε))次操作即可将任何块编码转换为n-正则块编码。最后，我们展示此构造诱导了矩阵的约当标准形对应特征值上的所需变换；对于不可对角化矩阵，这产生了完整的矩阵函数P(A)，其在每个约当块上的作用涉及P的导数，而不仅仅是映射λ ↦ P(λ)。

Möbius Quantum Computation: A New Topological Resource for Quantum Error Cancellation
papers.abstract: We formulate a Möbius chain mechanism for passive cancellation of coherent quantum errors under specified symmetry and evolution conditions. Möbius Quantum Computation (MQC) is a new topological boundary framework for quantum information processing, in which non-orientable boundary conditions enter explicitly into the effective quantum-state evolution. Here, we investigate a concrete consequence within this framework: the suppression of selected coherent error contributions through Möbius chain boundary conditions. While conventional quantum error correction uses redundant logical encoding, syndrome extraction, and active recovery operations, the proposed mechanism exploits a global non-orientable boundary identification, together with a compatible transformation of the error dynamics. The Möbius identification relates propagation along the chain to a twisted counterpart. The resulting cancellation depends on how the boundary transformation acts on the relevant error generators, rather than on the identification alone. We show that coherent phase errors accumulated along the ordinary branch can act against their topologically reflected contribution and they cancel themselves. The resulting mechanism is boundary-driven and passive. We formulate the boundary condition, derive the basic cancellation relation, discuss residual errors due to imperfect symmetry, and compare the proposal with dynamical decoupling, decoherence-free subspaces, stabilizer codes, and topological quantum computation. The present results identify Möbius boundary conditions as a promising and efficient resource that may complement and optimize conventional quantum error mitigation and quantum error correction. Our quantum approach is theoretical and conceptual. Its engineering and experimental architecture deserve further investigation.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们针对在特定对称性和演化条件下相干量子误差的被动抵消，建立了一种莫比乌斯链机制。莫比乌斯量子计算（MQC）是一种用于量子信息处理的新拓扑边界框架，其中不可定向边界条件显式进入有效量子态演化。在此，我们研究该框架内一个具体的后果：通过莫比乌斯链边界条件抑制选定的相干误差贡献。传统量子误差校正使用冗余逻辑编码、 syndrome extraction 和主动恢复操作，而所提出的机制利用全局不可定向边界识别，以及误差动力学的相容变换。莫比乌斯识别将沿链的传播与一个扭曲的对应物联系起来。由此产生的抵消取决于边界变换如何作用于相关误差生成元，而不是仅取决于识别本身。我们表明，沿普通分支积累的相干相位误差可以与其拓扑反射贡献相抗并自我抵消。由此产生的机制是边界驱动且被动的。我们表述了边界条件，推导了基本抵消关系，讨论了由于不完美对称性导致的残余误差，并将该方案与动力学解耦、无退相干子空间、 stabilizer 码和拓扑量子计算进行了比较。当前结果将莫比乌斯边界条件识别为一种有前景且高效的资源，可能补充和优化传统量子误差缓解和量子误差校正。我们的量子方法是理论性和概念性的。其工程和实验架构值得进一步研究。

papers.title: In-memory measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution
papers.abstract: Quantum memories offer to significantly extend the performance of quantum networks, but their complexity and limited performance at telecommunication wavelengths have so far hindered practical deployment. We propose a memory-assisted measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) protocol based on in-memory interference. Our approach leverages progress in atomic ensemble memories that enable the interference of a stationary matter qubit and a traveling photonic qubit inside a single quantum memory. We quantitatively evaluate the performance of this scheme against memoryless MDI-QKD and existing two-memory architectures, showing that it not only achieves superior secret key rates and surpasses the memoryless bound at substantially shorter distances, but also reduces hardware requirements by halving the number of memories and detectors. Our results further indicate that off-resonant cascaded absorption memories are a particularly promising platform for implementing this protocol, and we outline a concrete design compatible with their capabilities. These findings demonstrate that in-memory interference provides a higher performance and a resource efficient route toward near-term memory-enhanced quantum secure communications.
papers.abstract_zh: 量子存储器有望显著扩展量子网络的性能，但其复杂性以及在电信波长下的有限性能迄今阻碍了实际部署。我们提出了一种基于内存干涉的存储辅助测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）协议。我们的方法利用了原子系综存储器的进展，使得单个量子存储器内部的静止物质量子比特与行进光子量子比特能够发生干涉。我们定量评估了该方案相对于无存储器MDI-QKD和现有双存储器架构的性能，结果表明，它不仅实现了更优的密钥率并在显著更短的距离上超越了无存储器极限，而且通过将存储器和探测器的数量减半降低了硬件需求。我们的结果进一步表明，非共振级联吸收存储器是实施该协议特别有前景的平台，并且我们概述了一种与其能力相符的具体设计。这些发现表明，内存干涉为近期存储增强型量子安全通信提供了一条更高性能和资源高效的途径。

Directional and Correlated Optical Emission from a Waveguide-Engineered Molecule with Local Control
papers.abstract: Radiative coupling between quantum emitters leads to a range of spectacular emission phenomena. Dicke studied the foundations of collectively enhanced and suppressed decay, commonly referred to as super- and subradiance. Collective effects can further result in directionality of the emission, thus offering a complimentary implementation of chiral quantum optics. Waveguide quantum electrodynamics (QED) allows coupling between spatially separated emitters, enabling selective driving. In this work, we control the emission direction for a pair of quantum dots embedded in a bidirectional photonic crystal waveguide offering independent electrical tuning. Notably the emitters are 13 μ m apart, which corresponds to more than 25 effective wavelengths, but are nevertheless radiatively coupled. The directionality arises from a dispersive dipole-dipole interaction, which shifts the energy of the collective states, so that the emitter pair effectively forms an artificial molecule. We show that the emission direction can be switched from left- to rightwards by manipulating the relative driving phase while collectively exciting the emitters. In addition, we observe directional photon statistics under continuous driving, with, for example, single photons detected on one output port, and photon pairs on the other. With pulsed excitation, both emitters are fully inverted and correlated photon pairs are observed in time-resolved intensity correlation measurements. This work demonstrates a novel implementation of chiral quantum optics using quantum dots coupled via a non-chiral waveguide and reports key steps for scaling up as a multi-emitter waveguide QED platform.
papers.abstract_zh: 量子发射体之间的辐射耦合会导致一系列引人注目的发射现象。Dicke研究了集体增强和抑制衰变的基础，通常称为超辐射和亚辐射。集体效应还可进一步导致发射的方向性，从而为手性量子光学提供一种互补的实现方式。波导量子电动力学（QED）允许空间分离的发射体之间发生耦合，从而实现选择性驱动。在本工作中，我们控制嵌入双向光子晶体波导中的一对量子点的发射方向，该波导提供独立的电调谐。值得注意的是，这些发射体相距13 μm，对应超过25个有效波长，但仍然存在辐射耦合。方向性源于色散偶极-偶极相互作用，该相互作用移动集体态的能量，使发射体对有效地形成一个人造分子。我们表明，通过在集体激发发射体时操纵相对驱动相位，发射方向可以从向左切换为向右。此外，我们在连续驱动下观察到方向性光子统计，例如在一个输出端口检测到单光子，而在另一个端口检测到光子对。在脉冲激发下，两个发射体完全反转，并且在时间分辨强度关联测量中观察到相关光子对。本工作展示了一种使用通过非手性波导耦合的量子点实现手性量子光学的新方案，并报告了将其扩展为多发射体波导QED平台的关键步骤。

papers.abstract: Coherent collective dynamics of strongly interacting qubits are a central resource in quantum information science, with applications from quantum computing and simulation to metrology. While electronic spins interact strongly via dipolar couplings in dense solid-state ensembles, imperfections and positional disorder pose major obstacles to coherent correlated behavior, limiting their usefulness. Here, we realize collective many-body dynamics by combining time-dependent magnetic field gradients with global coherent control of dense electron spin ensembles in diamond. We control and probe the dynamics of nanometer-scale spin spirals, and, by exploiting Hamiltonian engineering that enhances the microscopic symmetry of the interactions, we observe a disorder-resilient collective spin evolution. Our results establish a pathway to interaction-enhanced quantum metrology and nanoscale imaging of materials and biological systems under ambient conditions.
papers.abstract_zh: 强相互作用量子比特的相干集体动力学是量子信息科学的核心资源，应用涵盖量子计算、量子模拟到计量学。尽管电子自旋在致密固态系综中通过偶极耦合强烈相互作用，但缺陷和位置无序对相干关联行为构成重大障碍，限制了其可用性。在此，我们通过将时间依赖磁场梯度与金刚石中致密电子自旋系综的全局相干控制相结合，实现了集体多体动力学。我们控制并探测纳米尺度自旋螺旋的动力学，并利用增强相互作用微观对称性的哈密顿量工程，观察到抗无序的集体自旋演化。我们的结果确立了通往相互作用增强的量子计量学以及环境条件下材料和生物系统纳米尺度成像的途径。

papers.title: A near-quantum-limited diamond maser amplifier operating at millikelvin temperatures
papers.abstract: Current microwave quantum technologies require the amplification of weak signals with minimal added noise at millikelvin temperatures. To date, this stringent requirement has been met exclusively by superconducting technologies, such as Josephson or kinetic-inductance parametric amplifiers. A fundamentally distinct alternative approach could be offered by masers, the microwave counterpart of lasers, which were predicted as early as the 1950s to achieve quantum-limited noise performance under ideal conditions. However, their dependence on cryogenic operation historically limited further advancement. Here we demonstrate the first-ever non-superconducting, near-quantum-limited maser amplifier operating at millikelvin temperatures utilising nitrogen impurity spins (P1 centres) in diamond. Population inversion is achieved via microwave pumping, exploiting a four-spin cross-relaxation mechanism. We realise a maximum power gain exceeding 30 dB, an added noise of approximately 2.55 quanta above the standard quantum limit, and a maximum 1 dB output compression point of −63 dBm at 6.595 GHz. The ability to operate in strong static magnetic fields of arbitrary orientation may offer a complementary, non-superconducting route for applications such as semiconducting spin-qubit readout, magnetic-resonance spectroscopy, and dark-matter axion searches.
papers.abstract_zh: 当前的微波量子技术需要在毫开尔文温度下以最小附加噪声放大微弱信号。迄今为止，这一严苛要求仅由超导技术满足，例如约瑟夫森参量放大器或动能电感参量放大器。一种根本不同的替代方案可能由微波激射器提供，它是激光器的微波对应物，早在20世纪50年代就被预测可在理想条件下实现量子极限噪声性能。然而，它们对低温运行的依赖在历史上限制了进一步发展。在此，我们展示了首个非超导、接近量子极限的微波激射放大器，在毫开尔文温度下运行，利用金刚石中的氮杂质自旋（P1中心）。通过微波泵浦实现粒子数反转，利用四自旋交叉弛豫机制。我们实现了超过30 dB的最大功率增益、约高于标准量子极限2.55个量子的附加噪声，以及在6.595 GHz下−63 dBm的最大1 dB输出压缩点。在任意取向的强静态磁场中运行的能力可能为半导体自旋量子比特读出、磁共振谱学和暗物质轴子搜索等应用提供一种互补的、非超导的途径。

papers.abstract: The influence matrix (IM) provides a powerful framework for characterizing nonequilibrium quantum many-body dynamics by encoding multitime correlations into tensor-network states. Understanding how its computational complexity relates to underlying dynamics is crucial for both theoretical insight and practical utility yet remains largely unexplored despite a few case studies. Here, we address this question for a family of brickwork quantum circuits ranging from integrable to chaotic regimes. Using tools from geometric group theory, we identify three qualitatively distinct scalings of temporal entanglement entropy, establishing a hierarchy of computational resources required for accurate tensor-network representations of the IM for these models. We further analyze the memory structure of the IM and distinguish between classical and quantum temporal correlations. In particular, for certain examples, we identify effectively classical IMs that admit an efficient Monte Carlo algorithm for computing multitime correlations. In more generic settings without an explicit classical description of the IM, we introduce an operational measure of quantum memory with an experimental protocol and discuss examples exhibiting long-time genuinely quantum correlations. Our results establish a new connection between quantum many-body dynamics and group theory, providing fresh insights into the complexity of the IM and its intricate connection to the physical characteristics of the dynamics.
papers.abstract_zh: 影响矩阵（IM）通过将多时间关联编码为张量网络态，为刻画非平衡量子多体动力学提供了一个强有力的框架。理解其计算复杂度与底层动力学之间的关系，对于理论洞察和实际应用都至关重要，然而尽管已有若干案例研究，这一问题在很大程度上仍未被探索。在此，我们针对从可积到混沌 regime 的一类砖墙式量子电路来探讨这一问题。利用几何群论的工具，我们识别出时间纠缠熵的三种定性不同的标度行为，从而为这些模型的 IM 的精确张量网络表示所需计算资源建立了一个层级结构。我们进一步分析了 IM 的记忆结构，并区分了经典时间关联与量子时间关联。特别地，对于某些例子，我们识别出有效的经典 IM，其允许一种高效蒙特卡洛算法来计算多时间关联。在更一般的、没有 IM 显式经典描述的情形中，我们引入了一种量子记忆的操作性度量及其实验方案，并讨论了展现长时间真正量子关联的例子。我们的结果在量子多体动力学与群论之间建立了一种新的联系，为 IM 的复杂度及其与动力学物理特性之间的复杂关联提供了新的见解。

papers.abstract: Two-dimensional quantum gases provide a distinctive setting in which enhanced thermal fluctuations, finite-size effects, and two-body bound-state formation are intrinsically intertwined. In this work, we study a single attractive impurity immersed in a finite, weakly interacting two-dimensional Bose gas, where finite size stabilizes a nonzero condensate fraction by introducing an infrared momentum scale, thereby enabling a Bogoliubov description of the bath. Using a hybrid approach that combines finite-temperature many-body scattering theory with path-integral Monte Carlo, we analyze the impurity quasiparticle energy in the condensate and normal regimes. We employ different approximations for the bath in the two regimes and therefore restrict our quantitative predictions to temperature ranges that lie outside the crossover between them. The infrared scale generates a phonon-activation temperature below which the impurity energy remains nearly temperature independent. Once the resolved phonon modes become thermally populated, enhanced impurity-bath scattering competes with condensate depletion and the narrowing of the phonon window, shaping the coupling-dependent temperature evolution of the polaron energy. These results suggest that attractive Bose polarons may serve as sensitive probes of finite-size thermal fluctuations, phonon dressing, and bound-state physics in low-dimensional Bose gases.
papers.abstract_zh: 二维量子气体提供了一个独特的场景，其中增强的热涨落、有限尺寸效应以及两体束缚态形成本质上相互交织。在这项工作中，我们研究了一个浸没在有限、弱相互作用的二维玻色气体中的单一吸引性杂质，其中有限尺寸通过引入红外动量尺度稳定了非零的凝聚体分数，从而使得对浴的Bogoliubov描述成为可能。采用结合有限温度多体散射理论与路径积分蒙特卡洛的混合方法，我们分析了凝聚体和正常 regime 中的杂质准粒子能量。在这两个 regime 中，我们对浴采用了不同的近似，因此将我们的定量预测限制在它们之间交叉区域之外的温度范围内。红外尺度产生了一个声子激活温度，低于该温度时杂质能量几乎与温度无关。一旦解析出的声子模式变为热占据，增强的杂质-浴散射与凝聚体耗竭及声子窗口的变窄相竞争，塑造了极化子能量依赖耦合的温度演化。这些结果表明，吸引性玻色极化子可能作为低维玻色气体中有限尺寸热涨落、声子 dressing 和束缚态物理的敏感探针。

Parameter-shift rules for gradients in boson sampling experiments
papers.abstract: Using a robust photon loss model for photonic quantum experiments, we derive n th order parameter-shift rules (PSRs) for computing gradients of Fock boson sampling transition probabilities where n photons are sent into a lossy interferometer. We also show that one cannot naturally generalize this gradient recipe to the case of Gaussian boson sampling. Only in the specific case where the transmission matrix of the interferometer can be factorized as a diagonal loss matrix premultiplied by a pure unitary it is possible to obtain PSRs with a finite order given by twice the total number of photons detected. We demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed method by comparing its performance against finite differences on real hardware.
papers.abstract_zh: 针对光子量子实验，我们采用一个稳健的光子损耗模型，推导出n阶参数偏移规则（PSRs），用于计算将n个光子送入有损耗干涉仪时，Fock玻色采样跃迁概率的梯度。我们还表明，无法自然地将此梯度配方推广到高斯玻色采样的情形。只有在干涉仪的传输矩阵可以分解为对角损耗矩阵前乘一个纯酉矩阵的特定情况下，才有可能获得阶数有限（等于探测到的光子总数两倍）的PSRs。我们通过在实际硬件上将所提方法与有限差分法进行性能比较，证明了该方法的有效性。

Making sense of quantum teleportation: an intervention study on students’ conceptions using a diagrammatic approach
papers.abstract: Quantum physics education at the upper-secondary level traditionally follows a historical approach, rarely extending beyond early 20th-century ideas, leaving students unprepared for comprehending modern quantum technologies central to everyday life and many facets of modern industry. To address this gap, we investigated how upper-secondary students and pre-service teachers understand quantum teleportation when taught with a simplified diagrammatic formalism based on the ZX-calculus, which represents quantum processes as diagrams of wires and boxes. Through phenomenographic analysis of video-recorded group work sessions, written responses to exercises, and a group interview, with a total of $n=21$ n = 21 participants, we identified an outcome space consisting of four qualitatively different, hierarchically ordered categories of description encapsulating the different ways of experiencing quantum teleportation. The categories revealed that a conceptual progression depends on how one understands the temporality in quantum processes, the role of entanglement in quantum teleportation, the active nature of quantum measurements, and interpretations of mathematical operations in the diagrams. Our findings indicate that while a simplified diagrammatic formalism for teaching quantum physics can provide an accessible entry point at the upper-secondary level, it does not automatically resolve fundamental conceptual challenges, and requires careful consideration in terms of developing teaching and learning sequences. Finally, these results provide educators with a deeper understanding of conceptual affordances and challenges for designing and improving instruction, while also highlighting the need for further exploring how students and teachers alike understand quantum phenomena.
papers.abstract_zh: 高中阶段的量子物理教育传统上采用历史导向的方法，很少超越20世纪初的思想，使学生无法理解现代量子技术——这些技术对日常生活和现代工业的诸多方面至关重要。为弥补这一差距，我们研究了高中学生和职前教师在采用基于ZX演算的简化图解形式体系（将量子过程表示为线和盒子的图）教学时如何理解量子隐形传态。通过对录像小组工作会话、书面练习回答和一次小组访谈的现象学分析，共$n=21$ n = 21名参与者，我们识别出一个结果空间，由四个定性不同、层次有序的描述类别组成，概括了体验量子隐形传态的不同方式。这些类别揭示出概念进展取决于如何理解量子过程中的时间性、纠缠在量子隐形传态中的作用、量子测量的主动性质以及对图中数学运算的解释。我们的发现表明，尽管用于量子物理教学的简化图解形式体系可以在高中阶段提供可及的切入点，但它并不能自动解决根本性的概念挑战，需要在开发教学序列时仔细考虑。最后，这些结果为教育者提供了对设计 and 改进教学的概念可供性与挑战的更深入理解，同时也凸显了进一步探索学生和教师如何理解量子现象的必要性。

papers.abstract: Optical quantum memories based on Er, with its telecom-compatible optical transition, could benefit quantum networking and linear optics quantum computing applications, if the requirements for high memory efficiency, fidelity, and storage capacity can be met simultaneously. Here, we demonstrate the first high efficiency memory in Er, with spin-state storage for 25 μ s and classical efficiencies up to 81%, using the rephased amplified spontaneous emission protocol. We show quantum storage along with high-fidelity entanglement of an output state and the state stored in memory, and a demonstration of multiplexing, storing 70 modes in the temporal domain. We use the results to discuss how, with modifications to the pulse sequences and experimental geometry only, the performance can be improved to meet the requirements for practical quantum applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 铒的光学跃迁与通信波段兼容。基于铒的光量子存储器有望用于量子网络和线性光学量子计算，前提是能同时满足对存储效率、保真度和容量的要求。本文利用重相位放大的自发辐射协议，首次在铒中演示了高效率存储，实现了 25 μs 的自旋态存储，经典效率最高达 81%。我们展示了量子存储，以及输出态与存储态之间的高保真纠缠，并演示了可存储 70 个时间模式的复用。根据这些结果，我们讨论了如何仅通过改变脉冲序列和实验几何布局来改善性能，以满足实际量子应用的要求。

papers.title: Half-integer quantum anomalous Hall effect in MnBi 2 Te 4 via nonmagnetic extension
Giant-atom-enabled quantum optics with valley-polarized photons
papers.abstract: Valleytronics and valley photonics exploit the valley degree of freedom to encode and manipulate information. Here we show that photonic valleys can be selectively addressed in quantum optics using a simple two-level emitter, provided it is coupled nonlocally to the field, thereby realizing a so-called giant atom. Specifically, we consider a qubit coupled at multiple points to an engineered honeycomb lattice of resonators with detuned sublattice frequencies. By tailoring the geometry and phases of the coupling points, the giant atom can be made to emit selectively into a single valley. The emitted photons thereby acquire a well-defined valley character and effectively nonzero Berry curvature. By placing the qubit near a domain wall between regions of opposite sublattice detuning, whose interface supports valley-polarized edge modes, emission becomes chiral along the domain wall. This provides a promising route toward implementation of single-photon disorder-robust chiral emission without breaking time-reversal symmetry of the electromagnetic medium in platforms such as circuit QED.
papers.abstract_zh: 谷电子学和谷光子学利用谷自由度来编码和操纵信息。在此，我们展示，在量子光学中，可以使用一个简单的二能级发射器选择性地寻址光子谷，前提是它与场非局域耦合，从而实现所谓的巨原子。具体而言，我们考虑一个量子比特在多个点耦合到具有失谐亚晶格频率的工程化蜂窝状谐振器晶格。通过定制耦合点的几何形状和相位，可以使巨原子选择性地发射到单一谷中。因此，发射的光子获得明确定义的谷特性和有效非零的贝里曲率。通过将量子比特放置在相反亚晶格失谐区域之间的畴壁附近，该界面支持谷极化边缘模式，发射沿畴壁变为手性。这为在电路量子电动力学等平台中实现单光子无序鲁棒的手性发射提供了一条有前景的途径，而无需打破电磁介质的时间反演对称性。

papers.title: Fully integrated entangled photon-pair source on a photonic chip for a wavelength-multiplexed multiparty quantum key distribution network
papers.abstract: The development of QKD networks as a possible answer to the threat to encrypted communication posed by quantum computers has given rise to a variety of concepts and implementations in recent years. In terms of the scalability of such systems, photonic integrated circuits (photonic chips) are a promising approach. This makes the systems not only much more miniaturized and robust, but also more attractive for industrial production. Here we present the concept and characterization of a photonic chip that can act as a source in an entanglement-based QKD network employing spontaneous four-wave mixing in microring resonators. In addition to photon-pair production, the chip also directly performs essential filtering tasks. Moreover, the photon-pair rate can be maintained constant over an extended period using a Pound-Drever-Hall locking method.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，作为应对量子计算机对加密通信构成威胁的可能答案，QKD网络的发展催生了各种概念和实现方式。就此类系统的可扩展性而言，光子集成电路（光子芯片）是一种很有前景的方法。这不仅使系统更加小型化和稳健，而且也使其对工业生产更具吸引力。在此，我们介绍一种光子芯片的概念和表征，该芯片可作为基于纠缠的QKD网络中的源，采用微环谐振器中的自发四波混频。除了光子对产生之外，该芯片还直接执行必要的滤波任务。此外，使用Pound-Drever-Hall锁定方法可以在较长时间内保持光子对速率恒定。

papers.title: Field-free transverse response in altermagnet and topological insulator heterojunctions
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate the transport properties of a topological insulator (TI) connected to two-dimensional altermagnetic (AM) leads in the absence of an external magnetic field. Exploiting the intrinsic time-reversal symmetry breaking of AMs, we report the emergence of a field-free transverse differential conductivity in the resulting AM–TI–AM heterostructure. Our analysis reveals that this transverse response is highly sensitive to the orientation of the Néel vector: a finite transverse conductivity manifests when the Néel vector possesses an out-of-plane component, whereas it strictly vanishes for in-plane orientations ( θ = π / 2 ) under symmetric chemical potentials ( μ t = μ b ) due to the restoration of symmetry between the k y and − k y momentum channels. Conversely, when asymmetric chemical potentials are applied ( μ t ≠ μ b ), this symmetry is broken, yielding a finite transverse response even for an in-plane Néel vector. Furthermore, we demonstrate that while the longitudinal differential conductivity exhibits Fabry–Pérot-type oscillations as a function of the TI’s chemical potential, the transverse conductivity displays a distinct antisymmetric dependence. Notably, the oscillatory behaviour of the longitudinal conductivity persists even at finite temperatures. Spatially, the transverse current contribution decays exponentially with position inside the TI region. We also find that both the longitudinal and transverse differential conductivities exhibit periodic oscillations with the junction parameter χ t = χ b . These findings provide a fundamental understanding of field-free transverse responses in spin-momentum locked surface states, highlighting the potential of AM–TI heterojunctions for next-generation spintronic applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们在无外磁场条件下，理论研究了连接至二维交错磁（AM）引线的拓扑绝缘体（TI）的输运性质。利用AMs固有的时间反演对称性破缺，我们报道了在所得AM–TI–AM异质结构中无场横向微分电导的出现。我们的分析表明，这种横向响应对奈尔矢量的取向高度敏感：当奈尔矢量具有面外分量时，会出现有限的横向电导；而在对称化学势（μ_t = μ_b）下，对于面内取向（θ = π/2），由于k_y与−k_y动量通道之间对称性的恢复，该横向电导严格消失。相反，当施加不对称化学势（μ_t ≠ μ_b）时，这种对称性被打破，即使对于面内奈尔矢量也会产生有限的横向响应。此外，我们证明，虽然纵向微分电导作为TI化学势的函数表现出法布里–珀罗型振荡，但横向电导表现出明显的反对称依赖关系。值得注意的是，纵向电导的振荡行为即使在有限温度下也持续存在。在空间上，横向电流贡献在TI区域内随位置呈指数衰减。我们还发现，纵向和横向微分电导均随结参数χ_t = χ_b表现出周期性振荡。这些发现为自旋-动量锁定表面态中的无场横向响应提供了基础性理解，突显了AM–TI异质结在下一代自旋电子学应用中的潜力。

papers.title: A Guide to Higher-Order Quantum Operations
papers.abstract: Many complex quantum phenomena require a description that goes beyond the standard paradigm of state preparations, evolutions, and measurements. A suitable framework for tackling such scenarios is that of , i.e., quantum operations that transform quantum operations. These objects are fundamental to modern quantum theory, and recent years have seen a proliferation of technical and conceptual results that fundamentally rely on them; they naturally emerge in quantum circuit architectures, correlated open dynamics, and investigations of quantum causality, to name but a few fields of application. In this tutorial, we provide a pedagogical introduction to higher-order quantum operations: we offer the tools to work with them in various contexts and firmly embed them within the current research landscape. Through this approach, our intent is to enable multiple points of access to the field, highlight the interconnectedness of distinct areas, and provide the means to meaningfully engage with state-of-the-art research developments. We conclude by identifying open problems and future research directions in this rapidly evolving field.
papers.abstract_zh: 许多复杂的量子现象需要一种超越态制备、演化和测量标准范式的描述。应对此类场景的一个合适框架是，即变换量子操作的量子操作。这些对象是现代量子理论的基础，近年来出现了大量从根本上依赖它们的技术和概念性成果；它们自然出现在量子线路架构、关联开放动力学以及量子因果性研究等诸多应用领域中。在本教程中，我们对高阶量子操作作教学式介绍：我们提供在各种语境中使用它们的工具，并将它们牢固地嵌入当前研究图景之中。通过这种方式，我们旨在为该领域提供多重切入点，突出不同领域之间的相互联系，并提供有意义地参与最前沿研究进展的手段。最后，我们指出这一快速发展领域中的开放问题和未来研究方向。

papers.abstract: Hybrid quantum platforms based on highly excited Rydberg atoms coupled to nanophotonic devices offer a promising route toward scalable quantum networks and integrated quantum technologies. However, the close proximity of Rydberg atoms to dielectric nanostructures makes these systems particularly susceptible to uncontrolled surface electric fields that can lead to a degradation of the excitation process. Here, we experimentally investigate Rydberg excitation of laser-cooled 87Rb atoms via the evanescent field of an optical nanofiber in the presence of fiber-guided red- and blue-detuned light fields as used to trap ground state atoms in fiber-based dipole traps. We observe a time evolution of the Rydberg excitation spectrum when both the dipole trapping fields are on and the additional spectral features that appear can be suppressed by applying an external oscillating electric field to the system, strongly indicating that surface charge accumulation is responsible for the observed spectral feature. The experimental results are reproduced qualitatively by a model that incorporates DC energy level shifts arising from electric fields generated by charges deposited on the nanofiber surface. We identify Rydberg–ground state collisional ionization, which is enhanced by the dipole trapping fields, as the dominant mechanism for charge generation. These results provide new insight into charge dynamics at dielectric nanophotonic interfaces and establish practical guidelines for mitigating surface charge-induced electric fields in fiber-integrated Rydberg quantum systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于高度激发里德堡原子与纳米光子器件耦合的混合量子平台，为实现可扩展量子网络和集成量子技术提供了一条有前景的途径。然而，里德堡原子与介电纳米结构距离过近，使这些系统特别容易受到不受控制的表面电场影响，从而可能导致激发过程的退化。在此，我们实验研究了在存在用于将基态原子俘获于光纤偶极阱中的光纤导引红失谐和蓝失谐光场的情况下，通过光学纳米光纤的倏逝场对激光冷却的87Rb原子进行里德堡激发。我们观察到，当两个偶极俘获场同时开启时，里德堡激发谱随时间演化，并且所出现的额外光谱特征可通过向系统施加外部振荡电场而得到抑制，这强烈表明表面电荷积累是所观察到的光谱特征的原因。实验结果可由一个模型定性地再现，该模型纳入了由沉积在纳米光纤表面的电荷所产生的电场引起的直流能级移动。我们确定，里德堡–基态碰撞电离——其被偶极俘获场增强——是电荷产生的主要机制。这些结果为介电纳米光子界面处的电荷动力学提供了新的见解，并为减轻光纤集成里德堡量子系统中表面电荷诱导电场建立了实用指导原则。

papers.title: Supersymmetric quantum criticality with discrete symmetry
Squeezed-light-enhanced multiparameter quantum estimation in cavity magnonics
papers.abstract: Improving multiparameter quantum estimation in magnonic systems via quantum noise suppression is a well-established and critical research objective. In this work, we propose an experimentally realistic scheme to improve the precision of simultaneously estimating different parameters in a cavity-magnon system by utilizing a degenerate optical parametric amplifier (OPA). The OPA enhances the estimation precision by decreasing the most informative quantum Cramér-Rao bound, which is calculated by employing the symmetric logarithmic derivative (SLD) and the right logarithmic derivative. We show that when nonlinearity is introduced into the system, quantum noise is significantly suppressed. Our results show how different physical parameters influence multiparameter estimation precision, and we provide a detailed discussion of the associated physical mechanisms in the steady state. Our results focus on exploring practical Gaussian measurement schemes that can be realized experimentally. In addition, we analyze the system's dynamics, comparing both the SLD quantum Fisher information and the classical Fisher information for both homodyne and heterodyne detection. This approach provides a robust foundation for multiparameter quantum estimation, offering significant potential for application in hybrid magnomechanical and optomechanical systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过量子噪声抑制来提高磁子系统中的多参数量子估计精度是一项成熟且关键的研究目标。在本工作中，我们提出了一种实验上可行的方案，利用简并光学参量放大器（OPA）来提高腔-磁子系统中同时估计不同参数的精度。OPA通过降低最具信息量的量子Cramér-Rao界来提高估计精度，该界通过采用对称对数导数（SLD）和右对数导数计算得出。我们表明，当系统中引入非线性时，量子噪声被显著抑制。我们的结果展示了不同物理参数如何影响多参数估计精度，并对稳态下的相关物理机制进行了详细讨论。我们的结果侧重于探索实验上可实现的实用高斯测量方案。此外，我们分析了系统的动力学，比较了SLD量子Fisher信息和零差及外差探测的经典Fisher信息。该方法为多参数量子估计提供了坚实的基础，在混合磁机械和光机械系统中具有重要的应用潜力。

papers.title: Spectrum analysis with quantum dynamical systems. II. Finite-time analysis
Spectrally Robust Photon-Pair Generation in Topological Waveguide Arrays
papers.abstract: Harnessing topological effects offers a route to protect quantum states of light from imperfections, potentially enabling more robust platforms for quantum information processing. This capability is particularly relevant for active photonic circuits that generate quantum light directly on-chip. However, the impact of topology on the spectral properties of parametric processes—crucial for scalable quantum photonic circuits—remains largely unexplored. Here, we address this question by investigating photon-pair generation via spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) in nonlinear waveguide arrays, combining experiment and theory. A systematic comparison of uniform, trivial, and topological Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) arrays reveals that only the topological configuration preserves a stable SPDC resonance spectrum under coupling disorder, with fluctuations in the resonance wavelength reduced by more than an order of magnitude. An analytical model captures the origin of this robustness in the band-structure properties of the interacting modes. Numerical analysis further shows that each SSH array can operate as a robust photon-pair source, enabling stable interference between multiple such sources and the generation of high-dimensional entangled states with high fidelity. These results establish nonlinear waveguide arrays as a promising platform for harnessing the interplay of topology and nonlinearity in quantum photonic circuits.
papers.abstract_zh: 利用拓扑效应为保护光子量子态免受缺陷影响提供了一条途径，有望实现更稳健的量子信息处理平台。这种能力对于直接在芯片上产生量子光的有源光子电路尤为重要。然而，拓扑对参量过程光谱特性的影响——这对可扩展量子光子电路至关重要——在很大程度上仍未被探索。在此，我们通过结合实验与理论，研究非线性波导阵列中经由自发参量下转换（SPDC）的光子对产生，来回答这一问题。对均匀、平庸和拓扑Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）阵列的系统比较表明，只有拓扑构型在耦合无序下能保持稳定的SPDC共振光谱，共振波长的涨落减少了一个数量级以上。一个解析模型从相互作用模式的能带结构特性中捕捉到了这种稳健性的起源。数值分析进一步表明，每个SSH阵列都可以作为稳健的光子对源，使得多个此类源之间能够实现稳定干涉，并生成高保真度的高维纠缠态。这些结果确立了非线性波导阵列作为在量子光子电路中利用拓扑与非线性相互作用的 promising 平台。

Quantum transport in disordered spin networks: Emergent timescales and competing pathways
papers.abstract: Quantum transport in disordered systems poses intriguing fundamental questions, such as the interplay of disorder, interactions, and decoherence, and has attracted significant interest. These fundamental aspects also have important implications in real-world scenarios, such as energy transfer in nanoscale systems (e.g., light-harvesting complexes) and quantum information transfer. This large body of work spanning broad research areas in physics, chemistry, and nanotechnology has led to major insights and advances, yet open questions remain, namely, in terms of the emergence of multiple timescales observed in the dynamics of such systems. Here, we investigate the emergence of multiple transport timescales in the dissipative dynamics of a spin impurity coupled to a small, spatially disordered network of spins. Using a two-dimensional tight-binding model with dipolar interactions and local dephasing, we demonstrate that geometric heterogeneity leads to hierarchical coupling strengths. This results in pronounced separation of dynamical timescales, far beyond those expected in homogeneous environments. By analyzing different metrics for dynamics, we identify distinct relaxation timescales associated with cluster-level equilibration and global equilibration. A minimal three-site model reveals the physical origin of the longest timescale: Strong internal hybridization generates an effective detuning that suppresses transfer to other weakly coupled sites, yielding a parametrically enhanced relaxation time in the weak dephasing regime. We corroborate this picture with nonequilibrium steady-state transport calculations and extensive simulations of disordered spin configurations, demonstrating orders-of-magnitude slowing of relaxation when hierarchical couplings are present. Our results highlight the central role of geometry and connectivity in spin networks and open quantum systems in general, and provide experimentally relevant predictions for relaxation times in small spin baths.
papers.abstract_zh: 无序系统中的量子输运提出了引人入胜的基本问题，例如无序、相互作用与退相干之间的相互作用，并已引起广泛关注。这些基本问题在现实场景中也具有重要意义，例如纳米尺度系统（如捕光复合物）中的能量转移和量子信息转移。横跨物理学、化学和纳米技术等广泛研究领域的大量工作已带来重要见解和进展，但开放性问题仍然存在，即在此类系统动力学中观察到的多时间尺度的出现。在此，我们研究了与一个小的、空间无序的自旋网络耦合的自旋杂质在耗散动力学中多输运时间尺度的出现。使用具有偶极相互作用和局域退相干的二维紧束缚模型，我们证明几何异质性导致层级耦合强度。这导致动力学时间尺度的显著分离，远远超出均匀环境中所预期的情况。通过分析不同的动力学度量，我们识别出与簇级平衡和全局平衡相关的不同弛豫时间尺度。一个最小三格点模型揭示了最长时间尺度的物理起源：强内部杂化产生有效失谐，抑制向其他弱耦合位点的转移，在弱退相干区域产生参数增强的弛豫时间。我们用非平衡稳态输运计算和对无序自旋构型的广泛模拟证实了这一图景，证明当存在层级耦合时弛豫减慢数个数量级。我们的结果突出了几何和连通性在自旋网络以及一般开放量子系统中的核心作用，并为小自旋浴中的弛豫时间提供了与实验相关的预测。

papers.title: Quantum resources and performance in the initialization-free Bernstein-Vazirani algorithm
Quantum metrological advantage of high-order squeezed states
papers.abstract: Quantum correlations can be harnessed to improve the precision in parameter estimation beyond classical capabilities. Under a standard interferometric or rotation protocol, it is well established that the optimal single-mode Gaussian state is a standard squeezed vacuum, which enables Heisenberg-limited precision. In this work, we investigate the potential metrological advantage of two distinct families involving high-order squeezing, namely, m th -phase and multisqueezed states. Our results show that these non-Gaussian states can grant a significant metrological advantage with respect to the optimal squeezed vacuum under equivalent conditions, i.e., at equal occupations. Their advantage holds at both low and large occupations, but its behavior critically depends on the chosen family of high-order squeezing. While higher squeezing orders enhance the advantage, this comes at the cost of higher-order observables in the measurement for full metrological performance. Finally, we study their robustness to standard decoherence channels, i.e., pure dephasing and zero-temperature damping. Employing standard squeezing as reference state, our results indicate a reasonable robustness against damping up to a certain noise strength, while their metrological advantage becomes fragile under pure dephasing. Our work shows the potential enhancement in quantum metrology beyond Gaussian states, carefully detailing the main challenges and limitations.
papers.abstract_zh: 量子关联可以被用来提升参数估计的精度，超越经典能力。在标准干涉或旋转协议下，众所周知，最优的单模高斯态是标准压缩真空态，它能实现海森堡极限精度。在本工作中，我们研究了两个涉及高阶压缩的不同族，即m相位态和多压缩态，所具有的潜在计量优势。我们的结果表明，在同等条件下，即在相同占据数下，这些非高斯态相对于最优压缩真空态可以赋予显著的计量优势。它们的优势在低占据数和大占据数下均成立，但其行为关键取决于所选择的高阶压缩族。虽然更高的压缩阶数会增强优势，但这是以测量中需要更高阶可观测量的代价来实现完整计量性能的。最后，我们研究了它们对标准退相干信道的鲁棒性，即纯退相位和零温阻尼。以标准压缩态作为参考态，我们的结果表明，在一定的噪声强度范围内，它们对阻尼具有合理的鲁棒性，而在纯退相位下它们的计量优势变得脆弱。我们的工作展示了超越高斯态的量子计量学潜在增强，并仔细详述了主要挑战和局限性。

papers.title: Quantum Theory of Exciton Magnetic Moment: Interaction and Quantum Geometric Effects
Quantum Machine Learning: An Experimental Survey
papers.abstract: Quantum machine learning (QML) is advancing rapidly, yet it remains unclear which artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities benefit from quantum approaches, how strong the supporting evidence is, and whether reported gains justify claims of practical quantum advantage. This bounded critical survey introduces the Quantum AI Stack (QAIS), a capability-centered framework covering ten functional areas, and applies it to 107 experimental studies first released from 2024 to 6 August 2026, identified through keyword searches of arXiv, IEEE Xplore and the ACM Digital Library and reported following PRISMA 2020. Each study was appraised on seven weighted criteria, including comparison fairness, statistical practice, reproducibility and hardware realism, and each capability was assigned a level in a five-level maturity model. Within this corpus, quantum feature learning, quantum neural networks, hybrid quantum AI and quantum optimization have the most thoroughly corroborated evidence, much of it establishing parity rather than advantage, and no capability is deployable. Benefits that survive fair classical comparison are narrow and study-specific, including benchmark-specific accuracy gains and improvements in parameter efficiency, robustness, throughput and energy. None establishes practical quantum advantage, and null or negative findings occur at every level of evidence quality. Because inter-rater agreement was limited, the maturity assignments are provisional.
papers.abstract_zh: 量子机器学习（QML）正在迅速发展，但目前尚不清楚哪些人工智能（AI）能力能从量子方法中受益、支持证据有多强，以及所报告的收益是否足以支持实际量子优势的主张。本 bounded critical survey 引入了量子AI栈（QAIS），这是一个以能力为中心、涵盖十个功能领域的框架，并将其应用于107项实验研究，这些研究最初于2024年至2026年8月6日期间发布，通过arXiv、IEEE Xplore和ACM Digital Library的关键词检索识别，并按照PRISMA 2020进行报告。每项研究均依据七项加权标准进行评估，包括比较公平性、统计实践、可复现性和硬件现实性，并且每项能力在五级成熟度模型中被赋予一个等级。在该语料库中，量子特征学习、量子神经网络、混合量子AI和量子优化拥有最充分确证的证据，其中大部分证据确立的是持平而非优势，且没有任何能力可部署。在公平的经典比较下仍能成立的收益是狭窄且针对具体研究的，包括特定基准上的准确率提升以及在参数效率、鲁棒性、吞吐量和能耗方面的改进。没有任何一项确立实际量子优势，并且零结果或负结果在每一证据质量水平上都有出现。由于评分者间一致性有限，成熟度评定是暂定的。

papers.title: Overcoming the high-loss bottlenecks in measurement-device-independent quantum conference key agreement via multiparty advantage distillation
Optimal learning of quantum channels in diamond distance
papers.abstract: The evolution of quantum states can be described by quantum channels. The task of estimating an unknown quantum channel, known as process tomography, is a central problem in quantum information theory. A long-standing open question is how many uses of an unknown channel are required to learn it to a precision quantified by the standard metric for distinguishing quantum processes, known as the diamond distance. Here we address this by establishing the query complexity of channel tomography with optimal dependence on the dimensions of the input and output spaces and the channel’s Kraus rank at any fixed constant accuracy in diamond distance. We design an algorithm that establishes an upper bound and prove a matching lower bound for learning a channel to the given accuracy. Our algorithm follows the strategy of performing optimal tomography on the Choi-state representation of the process, and we show that channel tomography can be reduced to the well-studied problem of pure-state tomography. As channels subsume states, unitaries and measurements as special cases, our protocol provides a unified framework for tomography of these tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 量子态的演化可以用量子信道描述。估计未知量子信道的任务称为过程层析，是量子信息理论中的核心问题。一个长期悬而未决的问题是，要达到以钻石距离衡量的指定精度，需要调用未知信道多少次。钻石距离是区分量子过程的标准度量。本文给出了信道层析的查询复杂度。在任意固定常数精度下，这一复杂度对输入和输出空间维数以及信道 Kraus 秩的依赖均达到最优。我们设计了一种算法以建立上界，并证明了在给定精度下学习信道所需的匹配下界。该算法对过程的 Choi 态表示执行最优层析，并表明信道层析可以归约为已有充分研究的纯态层析问题。由于量子态、酉变换和测量都是信道的特例，这一协议为这些任务提供了统一的层析框架。

papers.title: Is the Large Uncertainty of δ C P Fundamentally Encoded in the Neutrino Quantum State?
papers.abstract: The precise measurement of the leptonic -violating phase δ C P remains one of the major open challenges in neutrino physics, as current experiments achieve only very limited accuracy. We address this issue through the lens of quantum estimation theory. A distinctive feature of neutrino oscillation experiments is that they cannot freely optimize the probe or measurement, since both are constrained by the production and detection of flavor eigenstates. We therefore examine whether the large uncertainty in δ C P originates from intrinsic properties—either of the neutrino quantum state or of flavor measurements—or if it instead stems from experimental limitations. By comparing quantum and classical Fisher information, we demonstrate that the limited sensitivity to δ C P originates primarily from the information content of flavor measurements. Furthermore, we show that, while targeting the second oscillation maximum, as in the ESS ν SB proposal, typically enhances δ C P information, this feature in fact strongly depends on the actual values of δ C P .
papers.abstract_zh: 轻子-CP破坏相位δ_CP的精确测量仍然是中微子物理中的主要未解难题之一，因为当前实验只能达到非常有限精度。我们通过量子估计理论的视角来处理这个问题。中微子振荡实验的一个显著特征是，它们不能自由优化探针或测量，因为两者都受到味本征态的产生和探测的约束。因此，我们考察δ_CP的大不确定性是源于内禀性质——无论是中微子量子态还是味测量的内禀性质——还是源于实验限制。通过比较量子和经典Fisher信息，我们证明对δ_CP的有限灵敏度主要源于味测量的信息内容。此外，我们表明，虽然瞄准第二个振荡极大值，如ESS ν SB提案中那样，通常会增强δ_CP信息，但这一特征实际上强烈依赖于δ_CP的实际值。

papers.title: Hardware-tailored logical Clifford circuits for stabilizer codes
papers.abstract: Quantum error correction is the art of protecting fragile quantum information through suitable encoding and active interventions. However, it is notoriously difficult to manipulate encoded quantum data without causing uncorrectable errors. Here, we introduce a mathematical framework for constructing hardware-tailored circuits that implement any desired Clifford unitary on the logical level of any given stabilizer code. We formulate this task as a discrete optimization problem that minimizes the number of CZ gates while naturally incorporating a parameterization of all Clifford stabilizers. Despite the intrinsic difficulty of the circuit compilation problem, our methods scale to at least 16 physical qubits. Because our circuits require very few CZ gates, they provide excellent starting points for constructing fault-tolerant implementations using flag gadgets. Using a brute-force search, we develop several such flag gadgets, including weakly fault-tolerant logical Hadamard circuits for the [[8, 3, 2]] code that require an unprecedentedly small number of physical two-qubit gates. Our work introduces both the mathematics and software for compiling hardware-tailored logical Clifford circuits. From a broader perspective, we turn away from the standard generator decomposition and instead focus on the holistic compilation of entire logical circuits, leading to significant savings in practice.
papers.abstract_zh: 量子纠错通过适当的编码和主动干预来保护脆弱的量子信息。然而，操控编码后的量子数据而不产生不可纠正的错误非常困难。本文提出了一个构造适配硬件的电路的数学框架，可在任意给定稳定子码的逻辑层面实现任意所需的 Clifford 酉变换。我们将该任务写成离散优化问题，在纳入所有 Clifford 稳定子的参数化表示的同时，尽量减少 CZ 门的数量。尽管电路编译问题本身很难，我们的方法仍可扩展到至少 16 个物理量子比特。由于所得电路所需的 CZ 门很少，它们适合作为用标志辅助模块构造容错实现的起点。我们采用穷举搜索设计了多种此类模块。其中，针对 [[8, 3, 2]] 码设计的弱容错逻辑 Hadamard 电路只需极少的物理双量子比特门，数量低于以往实现。本文提供了编译适配硬件的逻辑 Clifford 电路所需的数学方法和软件。从更广的角度看，我们从逐生成元分解转向对整个逻辑电路进行整体编译，在实践中显著减少了开销。

papers.title: Extracting Information from a Superradiant Burst Using Simple Measurements
papers.abstract: It is well known that superradiant decay of an ensemble of N spins generates a complex non-classical state of light. Here, we consider the estimation of a phase encoded in the initial spin state from a superradiant burst of photons: how is information about this phase distributed among the emitted photons and can the phase be estimated using simple measurements? Despite the complexity of the photonic burst state, we show that a simple homodyne measurement combined with an optimized filter and linear estimator recovers the N -scaling of the quantum Fisher information of the initial spin state (including cases exhibiting N 2 Heisenberg scaling). Even more surprising, the temporal mode with optimal information content contains a vanishing fraction of the total emitted photons in the large- N limit, suggesting an effective compression of phase information. Our results and setup represent a new approach to quantum metrology for spin systems, in that they enable cavity-based readout of solid-state spin ensembles that utilizes resonant spin-photon interactions.
papers.abstract_zh: 众所周知，N个自旋集合的超辐射衰减会产生一种复杂的非经典光态。在此，我们考虑从超辐射光子爆发中估计初始自旋态中编码的相位：关于该相位的信息如何在发射的光子之间分布，以及是否可以使用简单的测量来估计相位？尽管光子爆发态具有复杂性，我们表明，简单的零差测量结合优化的滤波器和线性估计器可以恢复初始自旋态的量子Fisher信息的N标度（包括展现N^2海森堡标度的情形）。更令人惊讶的是，在大的N极限下，具有最优信息内容的时间模式包含总发射光子的消失分数，这表明相位信息的有效压缩。我们的结果和设置代表了一种用于自旋系统的量子度量学的新方法，因为它们使得能够利用共振自旋-光子相互作用对固态自旋集合进行基于腔的读出。

A Century of the Schrödinger Equation (1926–2026): Recovering the Wave Picture and Its Physical Intuition
papers.abstract: One century after Schrödinger’s 1926 papers, the optical–mechanical analogy remains a useful guide to wave mechanics. This pedagogical perspective connects action and phase, stationary states, superposition, field modes, and electromagnetic gauge coupling. Its contribution is a unified account that explicitly separates exact identities, controlled approximations, and heuristic analogies. We distinguish Fourier representations from independently evolving momentum modes, exhibit the assumptions required to recover Hamilton–Jacobi dynamics, and separate classical mode selection from canonical field quantization. Electromagnetic phase factors are presented with their domains of validity, while operational measurement rules are distinguished from interpretative claims. The article proposes neither new dynamics nor a resolution of the measurement problem; it offers a physically motivated route through established results while identifying where classical wave intuition ceases to be sufficient.
papers.abstract_zh: 在薛定谔1926年论文发表一个世纪之后，光学-力学类比仍然是波动力学的一个有用指南。这一教学视角将作用量与相位、定态、叠加、场模式以及电磁规范耦合联系起来。其贡献在于提供了一种统一的论述，明确区分了精确恒等式、受控近似和启发式类比。我们将傅里叶表示与独立演化的动量模式区分开来，展示了恢复哈密顿-雅可比动力学所需的假设，并将经典模式选择与正则场量子化区分开来。电磁相位因子连同其有效性范围一并呈现，同时将操作测量规则与解释性主张区分开来。本文既不提出新的动力学，也不解决测量问题；它提供了一条以物理为动机的路径，穿过既有结果，同时指出经典波直觉不再充分的地方。

Quantum metrology of spin sensing with free space electrons
papers.abstract: Recent advances in transmission electron microscopy (TEM) have opened the path toward spin resonance spectroscopy with single-spin sensitivity. To assess this potential, we investigate the quantum precision limits for sensing magnetic moments with free-electron probes. Using a scattering model where an electron wavepacket interacts with a localized spin, we study two metrological tasks: estimating the magnitude of the magnetic moment and discriminating the presence of a spin. The sensitivity for a given measurement setting is generally determined by the classical Fisher information, which we benchmark against the quantum bound optimized over all measurements. We find that conventional TEM imaging can saturate the quantum bound when backaction (BA) of the probe electron onto the spin state is negligible. We also find that, when BA is relevant, one could do better by realizing a measurement of the electron’s orbital angular momentum state. These results establish the quantum limits of spin sensing in TEM and guide the development of future experiments probing individual electron spins or nanoscale ensembles of nuclear spins.
papers.abstract_zh: 透射电子显微镜（TEM）的最新进展为具有单自旋灵敏度的自旋共振谱学开辟了道路。为评估这一潜力，我们研究了利用自由电子探针传感磁矩的量子精度极限。采用电子波包与局域自旋相互作用的散射模型，我们研究了两个计量学任务：估计磁矩的大小和辨别自旋的存在。给定测量设置的灵敏度通常由经典Fisher信息决定，我们将其与在所有测量上优化得到的量子界限进行基准比较。我们发现，当探针电子对自旋状态的反作用（BA）可忽略时，常规TEM成像能够达到量子界限。我们还发现，当BA相关时，通过实现电子轨道角动量态的测量可以获得更好的结果。这些结果确立了TEM中自旋传感的量子极限，并指导未来探测单个电子自旋或纳米尺度核自旋系综的实验发展。

papers.title: Pump-controlled multilevel phase jump in dissipative cavity magnonics
papers.abstract: Dissipative coupling enables loss- and interference-based control of non-Hermitian microwave scattering, but the conventional two-mode cavity–Walker mode response supports only one 2π phase jump at a constrained frequency. Here, we introduce a pump-induced magnon mode coherently coupled to the Walker mode, with a pump-tunable coupling strength g that reshapes the complex transmission S21. Phase jumps are identified with transverse negative-real-axis crossings of S21, and four critical coupling strengths governing the creation, disappearance, and folding of the crossing roots are obtained analytically. At zero detuning, tuning g produces successive multiplicities of one, three, five, four, and zero. Varying the cavity radiative decay rate changes the threshold ordering and the accessible counts, while Walker mode–cavity detuning breaks the symmetry of phase jumps and allows their frequencies to be tuned jointly by g and the detuning. These results establish phase-jump multiplicity as a reconfigurable scattering property of dissipative cavity magnonics and could support pump-programmable phase-encoded microwave responses.
papers.abstract_zh: 耗散耦合使得基于损耗和干涉的非厄米微波散射控制成为可能，但传统的双模腔–Walker模响应在受限频率下仅支持一个2π相位跳变。在此，我们引入一个由泵浦诱导的磁振子模，与Walker模相干耦合，其泵浦可调的耦合强度g可重塑复透射率S21。相位跳变通过S21的横向负实轴穿越来识别，并解析获得了控制穿越根的产生、消失和折叠的四个临界耦合强度。在零失谐条件下，调节g可依次产生一、三、五、四和零的重数。改变腔辐射衰减率会改变阈值排序和可及计数，而Walker模–腔失谐打破了相位跳变的对称性，并允许其频率由g和失谐共同调节。这些结果确立了相位跳变重数作为耗散腔磁子学的一种可重构散射特性，并可能支持泵浦可编程的相位编码微波响应。

Efficient hybrid quantum-classical neural networks generation for crop yield prediction using sequential satellite images
papers.abstract: A novel approach is introduced that enables the automatic generation of hybrid quantum-classical neural networks using a two-step optimization process, combining multiobjective genetic algorithms specifically designed for time series on satellite images with a subsequent continuous refinement stage of the circuit’s parameters. This strategy provides models with low prediction error and low complexity in terms of trainable parameters. The application of this methodology focuses on using Sentinel-2 satellite images to forecast future values of the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), which holds great significance in agriculture since it is used as an indicator of crop health and yield. The hybrid model is evaluated on random validation pixels and full images, and compared against tuned classical baselines to assess its performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新方法，通过两步优化过程实现混合量子-经典神经网络的自动生成，该过程结合了专为卫星图像时间序列设计的多目标遗传算法以及随后的电路参数连续精化阶段。该策略使模型在可训练参数方面具有低预测误差和低复杂度。该方法的应用重点在于利用Sentinel-2卫星图像预测归一化差值植被指数（NDVI）的未来值，这在农业中具有重要意义，因为NDVI被用作作物健康和产量的指标。混合模型在随机验证像素和完整图像上进行评估，并与调优后的经典基线进行比较以评估其性能。

papers.title: Variational formulae for entropy-like functionals for states in von Neumann algebras
papers.abstract: The paper presents variational formulae for entropy-like functionals, including Segal and Rényi entropies, for normal states on semifinite von Neumann algebras. The considered functionals are of the form τ ( f ( h ) ) where τ is a normal faithful semifinite trace on this algebra, h is a positive selfadjoint operator from L 1 ( M , τ ) , and f is an appropriate convex or concave function. The results cover both finite and semifinite algebras, and the obtained formulae generalise known results, in particular, those concerning relative entropy. Moreover, the connection between quantum entropies and the structure of abelian subalgebras is highlighted, providing new interpretations in the context of quantum information theory.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文提出了关于半有限冯·诺依曼代数上正规态的熵类似泛函的变分公式，包括塞加尔熵和雷尼熵。所考虑的泛函形式为 τ(f(h))，其中 τ 是该代数上的正规忠实半有限迹，h 是 L1(M, τ) 中的正自伴算子，f 是适当的凸函数或凹函数。研究结果涵盖了有限和半有限代数，所获得的公式推广了已知结果，特别是关于相对熵的结果。此外，还强调了量子熵与阿贝尔子代数结构之间的联系，为量子信息理论提供了新的解释。

papers.title: Statistical benchmarking of optimization methods for a variational quantum eigensolver under quantum noise
Star-like topologies enhance the charging power of quantum batteries
papers.abstract: Quantum batteries are quantum systems that store energy and deliver it on demand, and their practical value hinges on how fast they can be charged. While collective charging protocols and global control are known to enhance charging power, it remains unclear how the battery’s internal interaction architecture itself constrains performance. Here we study interacting fermionic batteries whose internal couplings are encoded by a graph adjacency matrix and which are charged through a uniform interaction with an external fermionic device. We prove that the star topology uniquely maximizes the initial slope of the charging power at zero local field. At finite field, we derive an exact spectral criterion for outperforming the star and construct a star-like family that satisfies it. Based on numerically established correlation, we expect these findings to extend to the maximal average charging power as well. To confirm the dominance of the star architecture, we complement the analysis by an exhaustive sweep over all connected graphs with N ⩽ 7 vertices, and by larger random-graph benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 量子电池是储存能量并按需释放能量的量子系统，其实际价值取决于充电速度。虽然已知集体充电协议和全局控制能够增强充电功率，但电池内部相互作用架构本身如何约束性能仍不清楚。本文研究相互作用的费米子电池，其内部耦合由图的邻接矩阵编码，并通过与外部费米子装置的均匀相互作用进行充电。我们证明，在零局部场下，星形拓扑唯一地最大化了充电功率的初始斜率。在有限场下，我们推导出超越星形结构的精确谱判据，并构造了一个满足该判据的星形类族。基于数值建立的相关性，我们预期这些发现也可推广到最大平均充电功率。为确认星形架构的主导地位，我们通过对所有 N ⩽ 7 个顶点的连通图进行穷举扫描以及更大规模的随机图基准测试来补充分析。

papers.title: Simulating Gaussian boson sampling on graphs in polynomial time
papers.abstract: We show that a distribution related to Gaussian Boson Sampling (GBS) on graphs can be sampled classically in polynomial time. Graphical applications of GBS typically sample from this distribution, and thus quantum algorithms do not provide exponential speedup for these applications. We also show that another distribution related to Boson sampling can be sampled classically in polynomial time.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们证明，与图上的高斯玻色采样（GBS）相关的一种分布可以在多项式时间内经典采样。GBS的图形应用通常从这种分布中采样，因此量子算法为这些应用提供的加速并非指数级。我们还证明，与玻色采样相关的另一种分布也可以在多项式时间内经典采样。

papers.title: Sequential realization of Quantum Instruments
papers.abstract: In adaptive quantum circuits classical results of mid-circuit measurements determine the upcoming gates. This allows POVMs, quantum channels or more generally quantum instruments to be implemented sequentially, so that fewer qubits need to be used at each of the N measurement steps. In this paper, we mathematically describe these problems via adaptive sequence of instruments (ASI) and show how any instrument can be decomposed into it. Number of steps N and number of ancillary qubits n A needed for actual implementation are crucial parameters of any such ASI. We show an achievable lower bound on the product N . n A and we determine in which situations this tradeoff is likely to be optimal. Contrary to common intuition we show that for quantum instruments which transform n to m ( > n ) qubits, there exist N -step ASI implementing them just with ( m − n ) ancillary qubits, which are remeasured ( N − 1 ) times and finally used as output qubits.
papers.abstract_zh: 在自适应量子电路中，经典的中路测量结果决定后续门操作。这使得POVM、量子信道或更一般的量子仪器能够被顺序实现，从而在N个测量步骤中的每一步所需使用的量子比特数更少。本文通过仪器的自适应序列（ASI）对这些问题进行数学描述，并展示任何仪器如何分解为这种形式。实际实现所需的步骤数N和辅助量子比特数n_A是任何此类ASI的关键参数。我们给出了乘积N·n_A的可达下界，并确定了这种权衡在何种情况下可能达到最优。与常见直觉相反，我们表明，对于将n个量子比特变换为m（>n）个量子比特的量子仪器，存在N步ASI仅使用（m−n）个辅助量子比特即可实现它们，这些辅助量子比特被重新测量（N−1）次，并最终用作输出量子比特。

papers.title: Rotating-Wave and Secular Approximations for Open Quantum Systems
papers.abstract: We derive a nonperturbative bound on the distance between evolutions of open quantum systems described by time-dependent generators. We show how this result can be employed to provide an explicit upper bound on the error of the rotating-wave approximation in the presence of dissipation and decoherence. We apply the derived bound to the strong-coupling limit in open quantum systems and to the secular approximation used to obtain a master equation of the Gorini-Kossakowski-Lindblad-Sudarshan form from the Redfield master equation.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推导出一个非微扰的界限，用于估计由时间依赖生成元描述的开放量子系统演化之间的距离。我们展示了如何利用这一结果，在存在耗散和退相干的情况下，为旋转波近似的误差提供一个明确的上界。我们将推导出的界限应用于开放量子系统的强耦合极限，以及用于从Redfield主方程获得Gorini-Kossakowski-Lindblad-Sudarshan形式主方程的 secular 近似。

Quantum Fisher information and imperfect detection in a monitored fermion chain
papers.abstract: We study the metrological properties of a continuously monitored Kitaev chain in the presence of imperfect detection. The system is conditioned on a no-click record, while each emitted fermion is registered only with probability 0 ⩽ q ⩽ 1 . Because the conditional dynamics remains Gaussian, the steady state is fully characterized by the fermionic correlation matrix. This allows a direct evaluation of the quantum Fisher information (QFI) and of the mean Uhlmann curvature. For perfect detection, the monitored steady state retains a singular critical structure and the QFI with respect to the chemical potential becomes super-extensive. For any q < 1 , imperfect detection introduces a finite smoothing length that rounds the singularity and restores extensive scaling. Treating the detector efficiency as an additional estimation parameter reveals a generic multiparameter incompatibility for imperfect detection, with compatibility recovered only in the perfect-detection limit, where the mean Uhlmann curvature vanishes. These results show that incomplete trajectory information destroys the metrological enhancement associated with monitored criticality through a mechanism distinct from ordinary thermal smearing.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在不完美探测条件下连续监测的Kitaev链的计量学性质。系统以无点击记录为条件，而每个发射的费米子仅以概率0 ⩽ q ⩽ 1被登记。由于条件动力学保持高斯性，稳态完全由费米子关联矩阵表征。这使得可以直接评估量子Fisher信息（QFI）和平均Uhlmann曲率。对于完美探测，监测稳态保留奇异的临界结构，并且关于化学势的QFI变得超广延。对于任何q < 1，不完美探测引入有限的平滑长度，使奇异性圆滑化并恢复广延标度。将探测器效率视为额外的估计参数，揭示了不完美探测下的普遍多参数不相容性，仅在完美探测极限下恢复相容性，此时平均Uhlmann曲率消失。这些结果表明，不完整轨迹信息通过一种不同于普通热涂抹的机制破坏了与监测临界性相关的计量增强。
