Memory Physics, Finite Capacity, and Topology in Heterogeneous Quantum Networks
papers.abstract: Quantum-network capacity planning couples memory physics, finite storage, topology, and traffic. We study these interactions with a discrete-event simulator and six representative memory profiles. The simulator is validated against exact single-link, queueing, and swap-ASAP results and against the native SeQUeNCe protocol stack. The native comparison shows that a shared-multiplexing convention used in earlier versions of the model overstates the capacity gain from additional memory, so we report a per-slot model as the primary analysis and the earlier conventions as a sensitivity arm. A single frozen campaign of 266,736 time-based runs with 20 seeds per cell covers an atlas of six profiles, nine topologies, three loads, three network sizes, and seven per-node memory budgets, together with fixed-total-memory, coherence-time, heterogeneous-placement, and Sobol-sensitivity experiments. Under the primary model, the memory budget at which completion reaches 95% of its observed maximum has a median of 8 slots per node, depends more on topology than on memory profile, and reaches the grid boundary of 64 slots in 3.9% of 9688 regimes. Under the earlier conventions, it is strongly profile-dependent, with medians from 4 to at least 64 and 45.8% boundary cases. Four scalar reductions do not collapse the response (pooled quadratic R2 at most 0.152). Topology effects persist at fixed total memory after adjustment for path length. Request completion is independent of the coherence time T2 by construction and is governed by retrieval efficiency, attempt time, and the retrieval decay time τr; T2 enters through fidelity-qualified service. The retrieval-window parameter χr=τrpgen/tattempt orders the profiles by achievable completion but is not a memory-sizing law. Placing high-quality memories at hubs or betweenness bottlenecks outperforms peripheral placement in both model arms and under three interface-coupling rules. Memory-sizing conclusions are therefore sensitive to how multiplexing and storage are modeled and should be validated against native protocol implementations.
papers.abstract_zh: 量子网络容量规划耦合了存储器物理、有限存储、拓扑和流量。我们使用离散事件模拟器和六种代表性存储器配置来研究这些相互作用。该模拟器针对精确的单链路、排队和swap-ASAP结果以及原生SeQUeNCe协议栈进行了验证。原生比较表明，模型早期版本中使用的一种共享复用约定高估了额外存储器带来的容量增益，因此我们将每时隙模型作为主要分析，并将早期约定作为敏感性分析分支。一个包含266736次基于时间的运行、每个单元20个种子的单一冻结活动覆盖了六种配置、九种拓扑、三种负载、三种网络规模和七种每节点存储器预算的图谱，以及固定总存储器、相干时间、异质放置和Sobol敏感性实验。在主要模型下，完成度达到其观测最大值95%时的存储器预算中位数为每节点8个时隙，更多取决于拓扑而非存储器配置，并在9688个情形中的3.9%达到64个时隙的网格边界。在早期约定下，它强烈依赖于配置，中位数从4到至少64，边界情况占45.8%。四种标量缩减不能使响应坍缩（合并二次R2至多0.152）。在调整路径长度后，拓扑效应在固定总存储器下持续存在。请求完成度按构造独立于相干时间T2，并由检索效率、尝试时间和检索衰减时间τr支配；T2通过保真度合格的服务进入。检索窗口参数χr=τrpgen/tattempt按可实现完成度对配置进行排序，但不是存储器 sizing 定律。在两个模型分支和三种接口耦合规则下，将高质量存储器放置在枢纽或介数瓶颈处均优于外围放置。因此，存储器 sizing 结论对复用和存储的建模方式敏感，并应针对原生协议实现进行验证。

papers.title: Lower-depth local encoding circuits for the surface code
papers.abstract: The surface code is the most studied error-correcting code thanks to its high threshold, simple decoding, and locality in two dimensions (2D). A key component of any code is its encoding circuit, which maps an unencoded state to the corresponding encoded state. The best previous surface code encoding circuit compatible with 2D local connectivity requires depth 2 d to encode distance- d surface codes. This paper presents depth d encoding circuits for the rotated surface code. Our circuit is constructed inductively from circuits that grow the code from d to ( d + 2 ) . We prove that depth d + O ( 1 ) is optimal for inductively constructed circuits.
papers.abstract_zh: 表面码因其高阈值、简单解码以及二维（2D）局域性而成为研究最多的纠错码。任何编码的关键组成部分是其编码电路，该电路将未编码状态映射到相应的编码状态。先前与2D局域连通性兼容的最佳表面码编码电路需要深度2d来编码距离为d的表面码。本文提出了旋转表面码的深度d编码电路。我们的电路是通过归纳法从将码从d增长到(d + 2)的电路构建的。我们证明了深度d + O(1)对于归纳构建的电路是最优的。

Lindblad master equation for twisted photons in a turbulent atmosphere

Learning State Preparation Circuits for Quantum Phases of Matter
papers.abstract: Many-body ground state preparation is an important subroutine used in the simulation of physical systems. In this paper, we introduce a flexible and efficient framework for obtaining a state preparation circuit for a large class of many-body ground states. We introduce polynomial-time classical algorithms that take reduced density matrices over O ( 1 ) -sized balls as inputs, and output a circuit that prepares the global state. We introduce algorithms applicable to (i) short-range entangled states (e.g., states prepared by shallow quantum circuits in any number of dimensions, and more generally, invertible states) and (ii) long-range entangled ground states (e.g., the toric code on a disk). Both algorithms can provably find a circuit whose depth is asymptotically optimal. Our approach uses a variant of the quantum Markov chain condition that remains robust against constant-depth circuits. The robustness of this condition makes our method applicable to a large class of states, whilst ensuring a classically tractable optimization landscape.
papers.abstract_zh: 多体基态制备是物理系统模拟中一个重要的子程序。在本文中，我们引入了一个灵活且高效的框架，用于获取一大类多体基态的态制备电路。我们引入了多项式时间的经典算法，这些算法以大小为O(1)的球上的约化密度矩阵为输入，并输出一个制备全局态的电路。我们引入了适用于以下情况的算法：(i) 短程纠缠态（例如，任意维数下由浅量子电路制备的态，更一般地，可逆态）和(ii) 长程纠缠基态（例如，圆盘上的环面码）。这两种算法均可证明地找到一个深度渐近最优的电路。我们的方法使用了量子马尔可夫链条件的一个变体，该变体对常数深度电路保持鲁棒性。这一条件的鲁棒性使我们的方法适用于一大类态，同时确保了一个经典可处理的优化景观。

papers.title: High-Rate Scalable Entanglement Swapping Between Remote Entanglement Sources on Deployed New York City Fibers
papers.abstract: Entanglement swapping between photon pairs generated at physically separated nodes over telecommunication fiber infrastructure is an essential step toward the quantum internet, enabling applications such as quantum repeaters, blind quantum computing, distributed quantum computing, and distributed quantum sensing. However, successful networked entanglement swapping relies on generating indistinguishable pairs of photons and preserving them over deployed fibers. This has limited most previous demonstrations to laboratory settings or relied on sophisticated methods to maintain the necessary indistinguishability. Here, we demonstrate a scalable entanglement-swapping experiment using naturally indistinguishable entanglement sources based on warm atomic vapor cells. Without sharing lasers or optical frequency references between nodes, nor the need for pulsing the sources, we achieve a swapping rate of nearly 500 pairs/s in a local configuration while maintaining the Clauser–Horne–Shimony–Holt (CHSH) parameter above 2. Additionally, we demonstrate the scalability of our method by maintaining the quality of the entanglement swapping on 17.6 km of deployed fibers in New York City, relying on commercially available single-photon avalanche detectors at the spoke nodes, superconducting nanowire detectors at the hub and standard time-synchronization techniques. Our work paves the way for the practical deployment of large-scale hub-and-spoke quantum networks within cities and data centers.
papers.abstract_zh: 在电信光纤基础设施上，物理分离节点产生的光子对之间的纠缠交换是迈向量子互联网的关键一步，可实现量子中继器、盲量子计算、分布式量子计算和分布式量子传感等应用。然而，成功的网络化纠缠交换依赖于生成不可区分的光子对并在部署的光纤上保持其不可区分性。这限制了大多数先前的演示仅限于实验室环境，或依赖于复杂方法来维持必要的不可区分性。在此，我们展示了一个可扩展的纠缠交换实验，使用基于温热原子蒸气池的自然不可区分纠缠源。无需在节点间共享激光或光学频率参考，也无需对源进行脉冲调制，我们在本地配置中实现了近500对/秒的交换速率，同时保持Clauser–Horne–Shimony–Holt（CHSH）参数高于2。此外，我们通过在纽约市17.6公里的部署光纤上保持纠缠交换的质量，展示了我们方法的可扩展性，依赖于轮辐节点上商用的单光子雪崩探测器、枢纽节点上的超导纳米线探测器以及标准时间同步技术。我们的工作为在城市和数据中心内实际部署大规模轮辐式量子网络铺平了道路。

papers.title: Geometric characterization of non-Gaussian entanglement for finite stellar rank states
papers.abstract: We introduce a general framework for the analysis of non-Gaussian entanglement in bosonic states of finite stellar rank. The central result is the full characterization of their entanglement structure through the atomic decomposition of their stellar polynomial and its associated structural graph, whose connected components determine the mode-intrinsic entanglement content of the state and all partitions compatible with passive separability. An essential ingredient in this construction is the concept of essential variables, which identify the minimal number of effective modes involved in a core state, in direct correspondence with the symplectic rank. This reduction provides the foundation for decomposing stellar polynomials into atomic factors and for revealing the underlying entanglement structure. Building on this, we derive complete separability criteria for two-mode states, expressed through hyperplane decompositions of zero sets, and for stellar-rank-2 states across an arbitrary number of modes. Applications to several example states illustrate how the method isolates genuinely non-Gaussian resources and quantifies preparation complexity.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个用于分析有限恒星阶玻色态中非高斯纠缠的通用框架。其核心成果是通过恒星多项式的原子分解及其关联结构图，全面刻画其纠缠结构，其中连通分量决定了态的模式内禀纠缠内容以及与被动可分离性兼容的所有划分。该构造的一个关键要素是本质变量的概念，它识别核心态所涉及的最小数量的有效模式，并与辛秩直接对应。这种约简为将恒星多项式分解为原子因子以及揭示底层纠缠结构提供了基础。在此基础上，我们推导出了双模态的完全可分离性判据，通过零集的超平面分解来表达，并针对任意数量模式的恒星阶2态给出了完全可分离性判据。对若干示例态的应用说明了该方法如何分离出真正的非高斯资源并量化制备复杂度。

authors: Triyas Sapui, Keshav Das Agarwal, Tanoy Kanti Konar, Leela Ganesh Chandra Lakkaraju, and Aditi Sen (De)

papers.title: From the First Triangle to an Error-Correcting Lattice: Simulations of a Growing Bell-Pair Network
papers.abstract: In the Selection-Stitch Model (SSM), space is a lattice of Bell pairs that builds itself by two local rules: stitch adds a node in a triangle’s plane, and lift adds one above or below it, both at exact close-packed sites, so that every bond has the same length. From one tetrahedron, stitch generates only the face-centered cubic (FCC) lattice spanned by its edges, so FCC order is a closure property of the rules; the simulations measure the defects that growth adds. In 688 simulations of up to 1.2×106 nodes, with the bare rule, about 98% of cluster nodes four or more layers below the surface are FCC. Slabs grown on one close-packed sheet form twin domains and are 84–92% FCC; on a three-layer ABC substrate they grow as one variant. Read as a quantum state, the grown network has an entanglement entropy that counts the bonds crossing a boundary. Node parity checks with local repair turn it deterministically into a state of the FCC stabilizer code. Its distance is at most three, so it protects the lattice locally, cell by cell; checks are intact around 96% of cluster nodes three or more layers deep. The error-correcting lattice emerges from the postulate “what exists is what can persist”: only checked bonds of equal length persist, and the triangle is the smallest network whose bonds check one another.
papers.abstract_zh: 在选择-缝合模型（SSM）中，空间是由贝尔对构成的晶格，通过两条局部规则自我构建：缝合规则在一个三角形的平面内添加一个节点，提升规则在其上方或下方添加一个节点，两者均位于精确的密堆积位置，使得每个键具有相同的长度。从一个四面体出发，缝合规则仅生成由其边张成的面心立方（FCC）晶格，因此FCC序是这些规则的闭合属性；模拟测量了生长过程中引入的缺陷。在多达1.2×10^6个节点的688次模拟中，采用基本规则时，距离表面四层或更多层的簇节点中约98%为FCC。在单一密堆积片上生长的板状结构形成孪晶畴，FCC比例为84–92%；在三层ABC衬底上，它们作为单一变体生长。作为量子态解读，生成的网络具有纠缠熵，该熵计算跨越边界的键。节点奇偶校验配合局部修复，确定性地将其转变为FCC稳定子码的状态。其距离至多为三，因此它局部地、逐单元地保护晶格；在深度三层或更多的簇节点周围，约96%的校验保持完整。纠错晶格源自公设“存在即能持久”：只有等长的受校验键才能持久，而三角形是其键相互校验的最小网络。

papers.title: Fast simulations of X-ray absorption spectroscopy for battery materials on a quantum computer
papers.abstract: X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) is a leading technique for understanding structural changes in advanced battery materials such as lithium-excess cathodes. However, extracting critical information like oxidation states from the experimental spectra requires expensive and time-consuming simulations. Building upon a recent proposal to simulate XAS using quantum computers, this work proposes a highly-optimized implementation of the time-domain algorithm for X-ray absorption. Among a host of improvements to Hamiltonian representation, circuit implementation, and measurement strategies, three optimizations are key to the efficiency of the algorithm. The first is the use of product formulas with the compressed double factorized form of the Hamiltonian. The second is recognizing that for spectroscopy applications, it is sufficient to control the error in the eigenvalues of the (approximate) Hamiltonian being implemented by the product formula, rather than the generic error on the full time evolution operator. Using perturbation theory to estimate this eigenvalue error, we find that significantly fewer Trotter steps are needed than expected from the time evolution error bound. The third is the choice of an optimized distribution of samples that takes advantage of the exponentially decaying Lorentzian kernel. Through constant factor resource estimates, we show that a challenging model Li 4 Mn 2 O cluster system with 18 spatial orbitals and 22 electrons in the active space can be simulated with 100 logical qubits and less than 4 × 10 8 Toffoli gates per circuit. Finally, the algorithm is implemented on a simulator, and the reconstructed spectrum is verified against a classical computational reference. The low cost of our algorithm makes it attractive to use on fault-tolerant quantum devices to accelerate the development and commercialization of high-capacity battery cathodes.
papers.abstract_zh: X射线吸收光谱（XAS）是理解先进电池材料（如富锂正极）结构变化的一项领先技术。然而，从实验光谱中提取氧化态等关键信息需要昂贵且耗时的模拟。基于近期提出的利用量子计算机模拟XAS的提议，本工作提出了一种高度优化的X射线吸收时域算法实现。在对哈密顿量表示、电路实现和测量策略的众多改进中，三项优化是算法效率的关键。第一是使用具有哈密顿量压缩双因子化形式的乘积公式。第二是认识到对于光谱学应用，只需控制由乘积公式所实现的（近似）哈密顿量特征值的误差，而非完整时间演化算符的一般误差。利用微扰理论估计该特征值误差，我们发现所需的Trotter步数显著少于时间演化误差界所预期的步数。第三是选择优化的采样分布，以利用指数衰减的洛伦兹核。通过常数因子资源估计，我们展示了一个具有挑战性的模型Li 4 Mn 2 O团簇系统，其活性空间包含18个空间轨道和22个电子，可以用100个逻辑量子比特和每个电路少于4 × 10 8 个Toffoli门进行模拟。最后，该算法在模拟器上实现，并对照经典计算参考验证了重建的光谱。我们算法的低成本使其有望在容错量子设备上使用，以加速高容量电池正极的开发和商业化。

papers.title: Explainable quantum regression algorithm with encoded data structure
Emergent-Gravity Hall Effect from Quantum Geometry
Efficient Hamiltonian-aware quantum natural gradient descent for variational quantum eigensolvers
Cryptanalysis of Isogeny-Based Quantum Money with Rational Points
papers.abstract: Quantum money is a representative application in cryptography that utilizes quantum technology to achieve security that is unattainable with classical systems. Since the theoretical proposal by Wiesner in 1983, the most recent instantiation is the quantum money using class group actions on elliptic curves, proposed by Montgomery and Sharif in Asiacrypt'24. In this work, we propose a concrete cryptanalysis by leveraging the efficiency of evaluating division polynomials with the coordinates of rational points, offering a speedup of O ( log 4 ⁡ p ) compared to the brute-force attack. While the resulting attack still runs in exponential time, our method provides the first nontrivial algorithmic insight into their structural hardness. Furthermore, due to the algebraic properties of rational points and quadratic twists, our technique naturally yields a more efficient verification procedure for the underlying quantum money. We believe this new line of analysis opens promising directions for future research in elliptic-curve-based quantum cryptography.
papers.abstract_zh: 量子货币是密码学中的一个代表性应用，它利用量子技术实现经典系统无法达到的安全性。自Wiesner于1983年提出理论方案以来，最新的实例是Montgomery和Sharif在Asiacrypt'24上提出的基于椭圆曲线上类群作用的量子货币。在本工作中，我们提出了一种具体的密码分析，利用有理点坐标评估除法多项式的效率，相比暴力攻击实现了O(log^4 p)的加速。尽管由此产生的攻击仍以指数时间运行，我们的方法首次为其结构硬度提供了非平凡的算法洞察。此外，由于有理点和二次扭转的代数性质，我们的技术自然地产生了一种更高效的底层量子货币验证程序。我们相信这一新的分析路线为基于椭圆曲线的量子密码学的未来研究开辟了有前景的方向。

papers.title: Approximate error correction for quantum simulations of SU(2) lattice gauge theories
An unconditional distribution learning advantage with shallow quantum circuits
papers.abstract: One of the core challenges of research in quantum computing is concerned with the question whether quantum advantages can be found for near-term quantum circuits that have implications for practical applications. Motivated by this mindset, in this work, we prove an unconditional quantum advantage in the probably approximately correct (PAC) distribution learning framework with shallow quantum circuit hypotheses. We identify a meaningful generative distribution learning problem where constant-depth quantum circuits using one and two qubit gates are superior compared to constant-depth bounded fan-in and fan-out classical circuits as a choice for hypothesis classes. We hence prove a PAC distribution learning separation for shallow quantum circuits over shallow classical circuits. We do so by building on recent results by Bene Watts and Parham on unconditional quantum advantages for sampling tasks with shallow circuits, which we technically uplift to a hyperplane learning problem, identifying non-local correlations as the origin of the quantum advantage.
papers.abstract_zh: 量子计算研究的核心挑战之一，是能否在近期量子电路中找到对实际应用有意义的量子优势。受这一思路启发，在本工作中，我们证明了在浅层量子电路假设下，概率近似正确（PAC）分布学习框架中的无条件量子优势。我们识别出一个有意义的生成分布学习问题，其中使用单量子比特门和两量子比特门的常数深度量子电路，作为假设类的选择，优于常数深度有界扇入和扇出的经典电路。因此，我们证明了浅层量子电路相对于浅层经典电路的PAC分布学习分离。我们通过建立在Bene Watts和Parham关于浅层电路采样任务无条件量子优势的最新结果之上来实现这一点，并在技术上将其提升为超平面学习问题，识别出非局域关联是量子优势的根源。

papers.title: Tomography of transport pathways in selective-area-grown nanowires using angle-resolved conductance fluctuations
papers.abstract: Understanding the spatial distribution of carriers is important for interpreting transport in nanoscale devices. Here, we apply conductance fluctuation tomography to planar selective-area-grown InAs nanowires in both normal–normal and normal-superconductor device geometries. By tracking the evolution of conductance-interference features as a function of magnetic-field strength and orientation, we extract information about the geometry of phase-coherent transport pathways. By comparing the angular evolution of the conductance fluctuations with geometrical projected-area models, we distinguish between bulk-dominated transport, coherent near-surface transport across facets, and transport confined to individual facets. The measurements are consistent with transport dominated by a near-surface accumulation layer in InAs. Devices with normal contacts show behavior consistent with coherent transport across the nanowire apex, whereas hybrid normal-superconductor devices exhibit signatures of more facet-dependent transport. These results demonstrate how universal conductance fluctuations can be used as a tomographic probe of phase-coherent transport pathways in semiconductor nanostructures.
papers.abstract_zh: 理解载流子的空间分布对于解释纳米尺度器件中的输运过程至关重要。在此，我们将电导涨落层析成像技术应用于平面选择性区域生长的InAs纳米线，涵盖正常-正常和正常-超导体两种器件几何结构。通过追踪电导干涉特征随磁场强度和方向的变化，我们提取了关于相位相干输运路径几何形状的信息。通过将电导涨落的角度演化与几何投影面积模型进行比较，我们区分了体主导输运、跨晶面的相干近表面输运以及局限于单个晶面的输运。测量结果与InAs中由近表面积累层主导的输运相一致。具有正常接触的器件表现出与跨纳米线顶点的相干输运一致的行为，而混合正常-超导体器件则展现出更多晶面依赖性输运的特征。这些结果证明了普适电导涨落如何能够被用作半导体纳米结构中相位相干输运路径的层析探针。

papers.title: Thermodynamic speed limits in isolated quantum systems
papers.abstract: We derive thermodynamic speed limits for isolated quantum systems undergoing finite-time unitary driving. The key ingredient is a set of generalized second-law inequalities: For the Gibbs entropy and for several thermodynamically motivated observational entropies, the entropy production is bounded from below by a function of the Vu-Saito quantum Wasserstein distance between the initial and final coarse-grained states. These inequalities yield lower bounds on the operation time in terms of the average entropy-production rate. We apply the framework to system-bath coarse graining, local-energy coarse graining, and diagonal entropy, and illustrate the resulting bounds with numerical and analytically solvable examples. Our results provide a thermodynamic characterization of finite-time state transformations in isolated quantum systems and clarify how coarse-grained entropy production constrains macroscopic reachability.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们为经历有限时间幺正驱动的孤立量子系统推导了热力学速度极限。关键要素是一组广义第二定律不等式：对于吉布斯熵以及若干具有热力学动机的可观测熵，熵产生由初始与最终粗粒化态之间的Vu-Saito量子Wasserstein距离的函数从下方界定。这些不等式以平均熵产生率给出了操作时间的下界。我们将该框架应用于系统-浴粗粒化、局域能量粗粒化和对角熵，并用数值和可解析求解的示例说明了所得界限。我们的结果为孤立量子系统中的有限时间状态变换提供了热力学刻画，并阐明了粗粒化熵产生如何约束宏观可达性。

papers.title: The quantum Euclid algorithm and its application to factoring
papers.abstract: We present a quantum implementation of the Euclid algorithm for calculating the Greatest Common Divisor when one of the integers involved is a compound of two odd-valued primes. We discuss a possible application to the quantum factoring problem, for which modular exponentiation is no longer required, and the factors are revealed directly by measurements, although the method does not scale for large numbers in a favourable manner.

papers.abstract: Laser cooling is fundamental to quantum computing and metrology using atomic systems. Precise control often requires cooling atoms’ motional degrees of freedom to the quantum ground state, imposing operation time and architectural limitations particularly in large-scale systems. Here we demonstrate how the integrated optical control of interest for scaling trapped-ion systems additionally enables laser cooling that bypasses limitations of conventional schemes. Leveraging multi-channel integrated delivery of ultraviolet to infrared wavelengths for calcium ion control including in passively phase-stable ultraviolet standing waves (SWs), we experimentally verify a long-standing prediction by Cirac ., realizing Doppler cooling to below the conventional Doppler limit at a SW node. We also present the first realization of ground-state cooling via electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) using a “probe” beam delivered as a SW with atoms positioned at a node, predicted to enable multi-mode sub-recoil-limit laser cooling. We demonstrate cooling of motional modes spanning an approximately 5 MHz bandwidth from the Doppler temperature to near the ground state within 150 μ s , reaching n ¯ ≈ 0.05 phonon number occupancies for the target mode. Direct evaluation against the comparable running-wave (RW) scheme shows the SW implementation’s simultaneous advantage in cooling rate, motional mode bandwidth, and final phonon number, as previously theoretically predicted. Our work leverages capabilities enabled by integrated optical delivery to demonstrate fast cooling of multiple modes to the quantum ground state, and more broadly how scalable approaches to optical control can enable enhancements in fundamental atomic functionalities.
papers.abstract_zh: 激光冷却是基于原子系统的量子计算和计量学的基础。精确控制通常需要将原子的运动自由度冷却至量子基态，这在大规模系统中尤其会带来操作时间和架构上的限制。在此，我们展示了为扩展囚禁离子系统所关注的集成光学控制如何额外实现激光冷却，从而绕过传统方案的局限性。利用多通道集成传输紫外至红外波长以控制钙离子，包括被动相位稳定的紫外驻波（SW），我们通过实验验证了Cirac等人长期以来的预测，实现了在SW波节处冷却至低于传统多普勒极限的多普勒冷却。我们还首次展示了利用电磁诱导透明（EIT）实现基态冷却，其中“探测”光束以SW形式传输，原子定位在波节处，理论上可实现对多模式亚反冲极限的激光冷却。我们展示了跨越约5 MHz带宽的运动模式的冷却，从多普勒温度冷却至接近基态，在150 μs内，目标模式的声子数占据达到n̄ ≈ 0.05。与可比的行波（RW）方案的直接评估表明，SW实现在冷却速率、运动模式带宽和最终声子数方面同时具有优势，正如先前理论预测的那样。我们的工作利用集成光学传输所赋能的能力，展示了多个模式快速冷却至量子基态，更广泛地说，展示了可扩展的光学控制方法如何能够增强基本原子功能。

papers.abstract: Measurement-based quantum computation (MBQC) is a framework for quantum information processing in which a computational task is carried out through one-qubit measurements on a highly entangled resource state. Due to the indeterminacy of the outcomes of a quantum measurement, the random outcomes of these operations, if not corrected, yield a variational quantum channel family. Traditionally, this randomness is corrected through classical processing in order to ensure deterministic unitary computations. Recently, variational measurement-based quantum computation (VMBQC) has been introduced to exploit this measurement-induced randomness to gain an advantage in generative modeling. A limitation of this approach is that the corresponding channel model has twice as many parameters compared with the unitary model, scaling as N × D , where N is the number of logical qubits (width) and D is the depth of the VMBQC model. This can often make optimization more difficult and may lead to poorly trainable models. In this paper, we present a restricted VMBQC model that extends the unitary setting to a channel-based one using only a single additional trainable parameter. We show, both numerically and algebraically, that this minimal extension is sufficient to generate probability distributions that cannot be represented by the corresponding unitary model.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于测量的量子计算（MBQC）是一种量子信息处理框架，其中计算任务通过对高度纠缠的资源态进行单量子比特测量来完成。由于量子测量结果的不确定性，这些操作的随机结果若未被校正，会产生一个变分量子通道族。传统上，这种随机性通过经典处理进行校正，以确保确定性的幺正计算。最近，变分基于测量的量子计算（VMBQC）被引入，以利用这种测量诱导的随机性在生成建模中获得优势。这种方法的一个局限是，相应的通道模型参数数量是幺正模型的两倍，规模为N × D，其中N是逻辑量子比特数（宽度），D是VMBQC模型的深度。这通常会使优化更加困难，并可能导致模型训练效果不佳。在本文中，我们提出了一种受限的VMBQC模型，该模型仅使用一个额外的可训练参数就将幺正设置扩展到基于通道的设置。我们通过数值和代数方法表明，这种最小扩展足以生成相应幺正模型无法表示的概率分布。

Is data-efficient learning feasible with quantum models?
papers.abstract: The importance of analyzing nontrivial datasets when testing quantum machine learning (QML) models is becoming increasingly prominent in literature, yet a cohesive framework for understanding dataset characteristics remains elusive. In this work, we introduce a data-generation tool that allows to construct semi-artificial classical datasets tailored to quantum kernel methods (QKMs). Using this tool, we show that on fully classical datasets, QKMs can require fewer training examples than classical kernels to reach comparable error, providing clear empirical evidence that data-efficient learning with quantum models is possible on classical data. The main motivation behind this tool is to enable the community to perform controlled studies to figure out which dataset characteristics are particularly fitting for quantum models by tuning the data-generation procedure. Additionally, our study brings a spectral-bias–based generalization metric from classical kernel methods into the QML domain and shows that the performance predicted by this metric aligns closely with empirical results, thereby closing an important gap between theory and practice in QML generalization. Our tool paves the way for a systematic exploration of dataset complexities. This could potentially contribute to a deeper understanding of the generalization benefits of QKM models (extendable to a broader family of QML models) and shifts the search for quantum advantage from ad hoc benchmark hunting to principled dataset design.
papers.abstract_zh: 在测试量子机器学习（QML）模型时，分析非平凡数据集的重要性在文献中日益凸显，然而，一个用于理解数据集特征的内聚框架仍然难以实现。在本工作中，我们引入了一种数据生成工具，该工具允许构建针对量子核方法（QKMs）定制的半人工经典数据集。使用该工具，我们展示了在完全经典的数据集上，QKMs达到可比误差所需的训练样本可能比经典核方法更少，提供了明确的经验证据，表明在经典数据上使用量子模型进行数据高效学习是可能的。该工具背后的主要动机是使社区能够通过调整数据生成过程进行受控研究，以找出哪些数据集特征特别适合量子模型。此外，我们的研究将基于谱偏置的泛化度量从经典核方法引入QML领域，并表明该度量预测的性能与经验结果紧密一致，从而弥合了QML泛化中理论与实践之间的重要差距。我们的工具为系统探索数据集复杂性铺平了道路。这可能有助于更深入地理解QKM模型（可扩展到更广泛的QML模型家族）的泛化优势，并将寻找量子优势的方向从临时基准追逐转变为有原则的数据集设计。

Fokker–Planck Dynamics, Schrödinger Evolution, and Quantum Measurement: A Consolidated Compatibility Analysis with a Multimode Common-Clock Criterion
papers.abstract: Mathematical similarities between Fokker–Planck diffusion, Schrödinger evolution and quantum measurement do not establish physical equivalence. We identify separate requirements for stationary-density matching, a shared spectral clock, quantum-state admissibility and measurement statistics. For harmonic gradient diffusion, matching a quantum ground-state position density fixes only the ratio of spatial diffusivity to relaxation rate. A common clock across independently identified modes additionally requires equal relaxation-to-frequency ratios, equivalently equal mass-weighted diffusivities. Two independently calibratable residuals distinguish these requirements; circulating Ornstein–Uhlenbeck countermodels retain the matched stationary marginals without satisfying the common-clock condition. A laboratory test requires an independently specified carrier in the strongly overdamped regime; none is identified here. We distinguish density Fisher information from quantum Fisher information, specify the phase structure needed for local Schrödinger evolution, and state Husimi-state and quantum-channel admissibility criteria. A previously published completely positive measurement instrument provides a benchmark for finite-time records and backaction. Its Born weights and threshold preparation are supplied inputs. Selected earlier Architecture of Distinction (AoD) identifications are also clarified and corrected. Neither the Born rule nor an individual outcome is derived, and no parameter-free departure from quantum mechanics is predicted.
papers.abstract_zh: Fokker–Planck扩散、Schrödinger演化与量子测量之间的数学相似性并不确立物理等价性。我们确定了分别针对稳态密度匹配、共享谱时钟、量子态可容许性以及测量统计的独立要求。对于谐波梯度扩散，匹配量子基态位置密度仅确定空间扩散率与弛豫率之比。跨独立识别模式的共同时钟额外要求相等的弛豫-频率比，等价地，相等的质量加权扩散率。两个可独立校准的残差区分这些要求；循环Ornstein–Uhlenbeck反模型保留匹配的稳态边缘分布，但不满足共同时钟条件。实验室检验需要在强过阻尼区域中独立指定的载流子；此处未识别出任何此类载流子。我们区分密度Fisher信息与量子Fisher信息，指定局域Schrödinger演化所需的相位结构，并陈述Husimi态与量子信道的可容许性判据。先前发表的一个完全正测量仪器为有限时间记录与反作用提供了基准。其Born权重与阈值制备是作为输入提供的。选定的早期“区分架构”（AoD）识别也得到了澄清与修正。Born规则与单个结果均未被导出，且未预测任何无参数偏离量子力学的情况。

papers.title: Fermionic entanglement and quantum correlation measures in molecules
Emergent energy scales in magnonic systems with relative motion
papers.abstract: Relative motion between interacting systems can generate emergent energy scales that are absent in isolated systems. While uniform motion can be eliminated by a Galilean transformation, relative motion between interacting systems generally cannot. By coupling to an excitation’s spatial structure, relative motion generates a Doppler frequency determined by its wavevector and the relative velocity, providing a mechanism for driving nonequilibrium phenomena. In this tutorial, we illustrate these ideas using magnonic systems as a concrete platform. We first discuss motion-induced magnon transport between relatively moving ferromagnets, in which the Doppler frequency serves as an effective nonequilibrium bias in the perturbative regime. This mechanism produces magnon currents even without conventional driving forces such as temperature gradients or chemical potential differences. We then introduce motion-induced parametric instabilities. When the emergent scale becomes sufficiently large to resonantly create magnon pairs, the perturbative description breaks down, and the magnonic vacuum becomes unstable. This instability occurs above a critical velocity threshold and leads to spontaneous magnon-pair creation. Connections to related phenomena, including quantum friction, Cherenkov emission, and Zel’dovich superradiance, are also highlighted. The concept of an emergent energy scale provides a unifying framework for understanding transport phenomena and instabilities in quantum systems with relative motion.
papers.abstract_zh: 相互作用系统之间的相对运动可以产生孤立系统中不存在的涌现能量尺度。虽然匀速运动可以通过伽利略变换消除，但相互作用系统之间的相对运动通常无法消除。通过与激发态的空间结构耦合，相对运动产生由波矢和相对速度决定的多普勒频率，为驱动非平衡现象提供了机制。在本教程中，我们以磁振子系统作为具体平台来说明这些思想。我们首先讨论相对运动的铁磁体之间由运动诱导的磁振子输运，其中多普勒频率在微扰区域充当有效的非平衡偏置。即使没有温度梯度或化学势差等传统驱动力，该机制也能产生磁振子电流。然后我们介绍运动诱导的参数不稳定性。当涌现尺度变得足够大以共振产生磁振子对时，微扰描述失效，磁振子真空变得不稳定。这种不稳定性发生在临界速度阈值以上，并导致自发磁振子对产生。还强调了与相关现象的联系，包括量子摩擦、切伦科夫辐射和泽尔多维奇超辐射。涌现能量尺度的概念为理解具有相对运动的量子系统中的输运现象和不稳定性提供了一个统一框架。

papers.abstract: Quantum-mechanical interaction potentials support localized bound states below the dissociation threshold or delocalized scattering states above it. Although bound states are energetically isolated, scattering states couple a quantum system to environmental modes, making dissipation and loss intrinsic to open systems. Bound states in the continuum are an exception, as destructive interference keeps them localized within the scattering continuum. Theory predicts that such states can arise through interference between two Feshbach resonances coupled to a common continuum. Here we form such an interference-stabilized state in ultracold collisions of 6 Li atoms by coherently coupling two tunable Feshbach resonances using Floquet engineering. At a critical parameter point, elastic and inelastic coupling to the continuum vanish, producing a molecular state above the dissociation threshold. Consequently, resonant scattering features disappear and the colliding atoms become effectively transparent to one another. Full coupled-channel calculations and a minimal non-Hermitian model quantitatively reproduce our observations and identify the state as a Friedrich–Wintgen bound state in the continuum. These results show how quantum interference can control openness in quantum matter and enable the engineering of non-Hermitian Hamiltonians.
papers.abstract_zh: 量子力学相互作用势支持低于解离阈值的局域束缚态或高于解离阈值的离域散射态。尽管束缚态在能量上是孤立的，但散射态将量子系统与环境模式耦合，使得耗散和损失成为开放系统的内在特征。连续谱中的束缚态是一个例外，因为相消干涉使其局域化在散射连续谱内。理论预测，这种状态可以通过耦合到共同连续谱的两个Feshbach共振之间的干涉产生。在这里，我们通过使用Floquet工程相干耦合两个可调Feshbach共振，在6 Li原子的超冷碰撞中形成了这种干涉稳定态。在临界参数点，与连续谱的弹性和非弹性耦合消失，在解离阈值以上产生分子态。因此，共振散射特征消失，碰撞原子彼此变得有效透明。全耦合通道计算和最小非厄米模型定量再现了我们的观察结果，并将该状态识别为Friedrich–Wintgen连续谱中的束缚态。这些结果展示了量子干涉如何控制量子物质中的开放性，并实现非厄米哈密顿量的工程化。

Vortex dynamics driven transverse transport in superconducting thin films
papers.abstract: The generation of transverse voltage in superconducting thin films carrying a longitudinal current has been recently related to demonstrate exotic, symmetry-breaking transport phenomena. To understand the underlying phenomenon we chose two distinctly different systems to investigate; a conventional (Nb) and a nonconventional (Ni/Bi bilayer) superconductor. A systematic study of this transverse response in these type-II superconducting thin films we aimed towards establishing its microscopic origin. Both longitudinal and transverse magnetotransport measurements were carried out with Hall-bar patterned devices as a function of temperature with magnetic field applied out-of-plane. In both systems, a sharp, field antisymmetric transverse resistance emerges in the superconducting transition region, closely following the field derivative of the longitudinal resistance while it was vanishingly small or absent in the fully superconducting or normal states. Based on the vortex-flow model, the behavior could be quantitatively attributed as the transverse voltage arising due to the motion of Abrikosov vortices under a combined action of Magnus like force and viscous drag force, rather than from any exotic or intrinsic Hall-type mechanism. The close correspondence between a nominally conventional superconductor Nb and an unconventional superconductor heterostructure incorporating a ferromagnetic layer indicates that the vortex dynamics alone, independent of magnetic proximity effects or unconventional pairing, seems to be sufficient to account for the observed transverse signal. Our observations while seems to provide a quantitative, material-independent model for interpreting transverse voltages in superconducting films, raises the concerns in attributing such signals to exotic physics without first ruling out conventional vortex-flow contributions.
papers.abstract_zh: 超导薄膜中纵向电流产生横向电压的现象最近被认为与展示奇异的对称破缺输运现象有关。为了理解这一潜在现象，我们选择了两种截然不同的体系进行研究：常规超导体（Nb）和非常规超导体（Ni/Bi双层）。我们旨在通过系统研究这些II型超导薄膜中的横向响应来确立其微观起源。我们使用霍尔条图案化器件，在不同温度下以及施加面外磁场的条件下，进行了纵向和横向磁输运测量。在这两个体系中，超导转变区域内均出现了一个尖锐的、对磁场反对称的横向电阻，其变化紧密跟随纵向电阻的磁场导数，而在完全超导态或正常态时该横向电阻极小或不存在。基于涡旋流动模型，该行为可以定量归因于在类马格努斯力和粘滞阻力共同作用下阿布里科索夫涡旋运动所产生的横向电压，而非任何奇异或本征的霍尔型机制。名义上常规的超导体Nb与包含铁磁层的非常规超导体异质结构之间的密切对应表明，仅涡旋动力学本身，独立于磁邻近效应或非常规配对，似乎就足以解释观测到的横向信号。我们的观察似乎提供了一个定量的、与材料无关的模型来解释超导薄膜中的横向电压，但同时也引发了对以下做法的担忧：在未首先排除常规涡旋流动贡献的情况下，就将此类信号归因于奇异物理。

Symbolic Quantum-Trajectory Method for Multichannel Dicke Superradiance
papers.abstract: We solve Dicke superradiance with two or more competing collective decay channels of tunable rates using a symbolic quantum-trajectory construction. The method yields closed time-domain populations and observables as finite combinations of exponential terms for arbitrary numbers of emitters and arbitrary decay rates. For two channels, the behavior of the stationary ground-state distribution resembles a first-order phase transition at the point where the channel-rate ratio is equal to unity. For balanced d -channel decay, we obtain scaling laws for the superradiant peak time and intensity. These results unify and extend single-channel Dicke dynamics to multilevel emitters and provide a compact tool for cavity and waveguide experiments, where permutation-symmetric reservoirs engineer multiple collective decay paths.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们利用符号量子轨迹构造，求解具有两个或多个可调速率相互竞争的集体衰减通道的Dicke超辐射。该方法对任意数量的发射体和任意衰减速率，给出封闭的时域布居数和可观测量，表示为有限项的指数组合。对于两个通道，当通道速率比等于1时，稳态基态分布的行为类似于一阶相变。对于平衡的d通道衰减，我们获得了超辐射峰值时间和强度的标度律。这些结果将单通道Dicke动力学统一并推广到多能级发射体，并为腔和波导实验提供了一种紧凑的工具，其中置换对称的库工程化多个集体衰减路径。

papers.title: Surface Adsorbates Suppress Low-Frequency Noise for Shallow Nitrogen-Vacancy Centers
papers.abstract: Shallow nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond are promising nanoscale quantum sensors, yet their coherence is strongly limited by surface-induced noise. Surface adsorbates are widely believed to be a major source of decoherence. Here, we test this assumption by characterizing shallow single NV centers under ultrahigh vacuum (UHV) conditions, where the diamond surface is kept free of adsorbates, and comparing their behavior to ambient conditions. Surprisingly, we observe a ∼ 4 × reduction in the Hahn echo coherence time T 2 in UHV. By combining Hahn echo measurements in the single-quantum and double-quantum (DQ) bases, we separate contributions from different noise sources and find that both electric and magnetic noise are enhanced in UHV. In contrast, T 1 measurements reveal an increased DQ T 1 in UHV, indicating suppressed electric field noise in the ∼ 100 MHz frequency regime. These results point to a modification of the surface noise spectrum upon adsorbate removal, with different frequency regimes arising from distinct microscopic mechanisms. Specifically, we find that the low-frequency noise is consistent with increased surface charge in UHV that can be compensated by surface adsorbates in ambient conditions. Our findings highlight a complex and previously underappreciated role of surface adsorbates in shaping the noise environment of shallow NV centers, with important implications for nanoscale quantum sensing.
papers.abstract_zh: 金刚石中的浅层氮-空位（NV）中心是有前景的纳米尺度量子传感器，然而其相干性受到表面诱导噪声的强烈限制。表面吸附物被广泛认为是退相干的主要来源。在此，我们通过表征超高真空（UHV）条件下的浅层单个NV中心——其中金刚石表面保持无吸附物——并将其行为与环境条件进行比较，来检验这一假设。令人惊讶的是，我们观察到在UHV中Hahn回波相干时间T₂约减少4倍。通过结合单量子和双量子（DQ）基下的Hahn回波测量，我们分离了不同噪声源的贡献，并发现电场噪声和磁场噪声在UHV中均增强。相比之下，T₁测量揭示UHV中DQ T₁增加，表明在约100 MHz频率范围内电场噪声受到抑制。这些结果表明，吸附物去除后表面噪声谱发生改变，不同频率范围源于不同的微观机制。具体而言，我们发现低频噪声与UHV中表面电荷增加一致，而该表面电荷在环境条件下可由表面吸附物补偿。我们的发现凸显了表面吸附物在塑造浅层NV中心噪声环境中的复杂且此前未被充分认识的作用，这对纳米尺度量子传感具有重要意义。

Non-Markovian delay-assisted sensing with waveguide-coupled quantum emitters
papers.abstract: We show that in a minimal setup of two waveguide-coupled quantum emitters, separated by long distances and subject to an external field, time-delayed feedback can be a resource for sensing field gradients. While the field gradient induces a detuning between the emitters, the large interatomic separations render the system dynamics non-Markovian. We show that the quantum Fisher information for estimating the detuning parameter, and thereby the field gradient, is enhanced in the presence of non-Markovian delay. Such an enhancement can be attributed to the formation of atom-photon quasibound states that enable the field to interact with the emitters for longer times, thereby gaining more information about their relative detunings. Additionally, in the presence of delay, the interaction between the emitters is mediated via multiple spectral modes of the field, further enhancing the sensing capabilities of the system. Our results establish non-Markovian time-delayed feedback and multimode reservoirs as a resource for distributed quantum sensing with waveguide-coupled quantum emitters.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们证明，在由两个波导耦合量子发射器构成的最小设置中，当它们相隔长距离并受到外场作用时，时间延迟反馈可以成为传感场梯度的资源。虽然场梯度会引起发射器之间的失谐，但较大的原子间距离使系统动力学呈现非马尔可夫特征。我们证明，在非马尔可夫延迟存在时，用于估计失谐参数从而估计场梯度的量子费舍尔信息得到增强。这种增强可归因于原子-光子准束缚态的形成，使场能够与发射器相互作用更长时间，从而获取关于其相对失谐的更多信息。此外，在延迟存在时，发射器之间的相互作用通过场的多个谱模介导，进一步增强了系统的传感能力。我们的结果确立了非马尔可夫时间延迟反馈和多模库作为波导耦合量子发射器分布式量子传感的资源。

Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov transition and quantum criticality in polarized Fermi gases
papers.abstract: We investigate the zero-temperature transition from the polarized normal phase to the FFLO state in a two-dimensional Fermi gas by means of a diagrammatic t -matrix approach. We first show that the standard non-self-consistent theory produces an unphysical critical polarization because of a severe violation of the Luttinger theorem. Motivated by this observation, we introduce a minimal self-consistent extension that largely restores compliance with the Luttinger theorem while preserving the analytical simplicity of the original formalism. This leads to a physically consistent critical polarization over the whole interaction range. Building on this improved description, we characterize the quantum critical behavior of the FFLO transition through the quasiparticle decay rates, quasiparticle weights, momentum distributions, and the critical dynamics of both fermionic and bosonic degrees of freedom. We further compare the two- and three-dimensional systems, showing that their critical properties can be understood within a unified geometrical picture based on the nesting of the majority and minority Fermi surfaces. Finally, for a three-dimensional lattice, we demonstrate within the Hertz–Millis framework that vertex corrections are irrelevant, thereby placing the FFLO quantum phase transition in the mean-field universality class, in close analogy with the itinerant antiferromagnet transition.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们通过图解t矩阵方法研究了二维费米气体中从极化正常相到FFLO态的零温转变。我们首先表明，由于严重违反Luttinger定理，标准的非自洽理论会产生一个非物理的临界极化。受此观察启发，我们引入了一个最小自洽扩展，该扩展在很大程度上恢复了对Luttinger定理的符合，同时保持了原形式体系的解析简洁性。这导致在整个相互作用范围内产生物理上一致的临界极化。基于这一改进的描述，我们通过准粒子衰减率、准粒子权重、动量分布以及费米子和玻色子自由度的临界动力学来刻画FFLO转变的量子临界行为。我们进一步比较了二维和三维系统，表明它们的临界性质可以在基于多数和少数费米面嵌套的统一几何图像内理解。最后，对于三维晶格，我们在Hertz–Millis框架内证明了顶点修正是不相关的，从而将FFLO量子相变置于平均场普适类中，这与巡游反铁磁转变非常相似。

Dinuclear Cu(II) metal complexes as room-temperature energy storage quantum devices: review and outlook
papers.abstract: The urgent demand for sustainable energy storage devices necessitates the development of novel conceptual and technological paradigms that extend beyond the constraints imposed by classical thermodynamic limits. in order to present the material innovations required to enable viable room-temperature quantum technologies, this Review outlines the potential of dinuclear Cu(II) complexes as promising model platforms for the development of room-temperature quantum batteries. We address how the quantum properties of these dinuclear materials can be harnessed to store and extract energy, and how they can be handled and engineered by the management of the intra-molecular magnetic coupling and external thermodynamic conditions. Through macroscopic magnetometric mappings, we present how the maximum extractable work (ergotropy) can be directly quantified without invasive quantum tomography. Furthermore, we review the operational simulation of these materials using quantum computing approaches using the variational quantum thermalizer (VQT) algorithm on noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) devices. Finally, we provide an outlook on future research directions, highlighting the critical material engineering and quantum error mitigation strategies required to transition these coordination compounds from theoretical models to functional macroscopic solid-state quantum energy storage devices at room temperature.
papers.abstract_zh: 对可持续能源存储设备的迫切需求，要求发展超越经典热力学极限所施加约束的新概念和技术范式。为呈现实现可行室温量子技术所需的材料创新，本综述概述了双核Cu(II)配合物作为开发室温量子电池的有前景模型平台的潜力。我们讨论了如何利用这些双核材料的量子性质来存储和提取能量，以及如何通过分子内磁耦合的管理和外部热力学条件来处理和工程化这些材料。通过宏观磁测量映射，我们展示了如何无需侵入式量子层析即可直接量化最大可提取功（ergotropy）。此外，我们综述了使用量子计算方法在含噪声中等规模量子（NISQ）设备上通过变分量子热化器（VQT）算法对这些材料的操作模拟。最后，我们对未来研究方向进行了展望，强调了将这些配位化合物从理论模型转变为室温下功能性宏观固态量子能源存储设备所需的关键材料工程和量子误差缓解策略。

papers.title: Bounding the entanglement of a state from its spectrum
papers.abstract: We introduce a framework to upper bound the entanglement content of a bipartite quantum state from its spectrum alone. Using linear maps and their inverses, we derive rigorous constraints on the maximal entanglement that can be activated under global unitary transformations. We use as entanglement quantifiers the negativity and the Schmidt number; however, our framework is general and applies to any other entanglement measure. Our approach yields compact analytical sufficient criteria for bounding the entanglement of full-rank states in arbitrary dimensions and reveals new spectral constraints on Schmidt number witnesses.

papers.abstract: The work here enables a cost scaling of O ~ ( T 1 + o ( 1 ) l o g 2 ( 1 / ϵ ) ε ) and maximum depth O ~ ( T 1 + o ( 1 ) l o g ( 1 / ϵ ) ε ) for estimating observables after some Hamiltonian evolution e i H T using no extra block-encoding qubits, where ϵ is the algorithmic error of the target Hamiltonian evolution and ε is the statistical error from the observable estimation. Throughout, O ~ suppresses factors that are doubly logarithmic in 1 / ϵ (i.e. p o l y l o g l o g ( 1 / ϵ ) ), which are subdominant to the displayed p o l y l o g ( 1 / ϵ ) factors. This is achieved through product formulas, stable interpolation (Chebyshev), and to calculate the needed fractional queries, cardinal sine interpolation is used. This is an improvement over similar work using interpolation methods which have a superlinear scaling of the form 5 p T 1 + 1 / p , where p is the order of the product formula used and an improvement on required qubits over Quantum Signal Processing methods while maintaining scaling with p o l y l o g 1 / ϵ . This is accomplished through an optimized and variable (with T ) order p . The slightly better log 2 ⁡ ( 1 / ϵ ) compared to log 3 ⁡ ( 1 / ϵ ) comes from the use of cardinal sine interpolation compared to other methods using Chebyshev interpolation and product formulas. The work presented here also provides an alternative to Quantum Signal Processing techniques to calculate observables or amplitudes after a fractional query evolution with a cost O ( T log ⁡ 1 / ϵ ) through this cardinal sine interpolation.

papers.title: Ab initio simulation of excited-state potential energy surfaces with transferable deep quantum Monte Carlo
papers.abstract: The accurate quantum chemical calculation of excited states is a challenging task, often requiring computationally demanding methods. When entire ground and excited potential energy surfaces (PESs) are desired, for instance, to predict the interaction of light excitation and structural changes, one is often forced to use cheaper computational methods at the cost of reduced accuracy. Here we introduce a method for the geometrically transferable optimization of neural network wavefunctions that leverages weight sharing and a dynamical ordering of electronic states. Our method enables the efficient prediction of ground- and excited-state PESs and their intersections at the highest accuracy, demonstrating up to two orders of magnitude cost reduction compared with single-point calculations. We validate our approach on four challenging excited-state PESs, namely, ethylene, the carbon dimer, the methylenimmonium cation and a rubredoxin active site model containing 96 electrons, illustrating the potential of transferable deep-learning quantum Monte Carlo as a practical framework for studying electronic excitations in molecules.
papers.abstract_zh: 激发态的精确量子化学计算是一项具有挑战性的任务，通常需要计算成本高昂的方法。当需要整个基态和激发态势能面（PESs）时，例如为了预测光激发与结构变化的相互作用，人们往往被迫使用成本较低但精度降低的计算方法。在此，我们介绍一种用于神经网络波函数几何可转移优化的方法，该方法利用权重共享和电子态的动力学排序。我们的方法能够以最高精度高效预测基态和激发态势能面及其相交点，与单点计算相比，成本降低高达两个数量级。我们在四个具有挑战性的激发态势能面上验证了我们的方法，即乙烯、碳二聚体、亚甲基铵阳离子以及一个包含96个电子的红氧还蛋白活性位点模型，展示了可转移深度学习量子蒙特卡罗作为研究分子中电子激发的实用框架的潜力。

papers.abstract: Gibbs state preparation is an important subroutine in quantum computing. In this work we use the detectability lemma to improve Gibbs state preparation. Specifically, we design new Gibbs state preparation methods that do not rely on simulating Lindbladian evolution, thus avoiding the overhead from it. For local Lindbladians consisting of M terms, this approach reduces the cost by a factor of O ( M ) . We also combine the detectability lemma operator and quantum singular value transformation to implement ground state projection operators of frustration-free Hamiltonians, resulting in a quadratic speedup in the spectral gap dependence. Applying this method to Lindbladians for the Gibbs state of local commuting Hamiltonians, we achieve quadratically better dependence on the Lindbladian spectral gap.
papers.abstract_zh: 吉布斯态制备是量子计算中的一个重要子程序。在本工作中，我们利用可检测性引理来改进吉布斯态制备。具体而言，我们设计了新的吉布斯态制备方法，这些方法不依赖于模拟林布拉德演化，从而避免了由此带来的开销。对于由M个项组成的局部林布拉德算子，该方法将成本降低了O(M)的因子。我们还结合可检测性引理算符和量子奇异值变换来实现无阻挫哈密顿量的基态投影算符，从而在谱隙依赖性上实现了二次加速。将该方法应用于局部对易哈密顿量的吉布斯态的林布拉德算子，我们在林布拉德谱隙依赖性上实现了二次改善。

papers.title: Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm for a Frustrated Ising Model: Simulations and Quantum‐Hardware Experiments
papers.abstract: A frustrated Ising model on a two‐dimensional square lattice is investigated using exact diagonalization and the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA), with additional benchmarks on IonQ quantum hardware. The dependence of the ground‐state sampling probability on the number of QAOA layers and the frustration strength is analyzed. In weakly frustrated regimes, the probability increases rapidly with a modest increase in the number of QAOA layers. In contrast, in the strongly frustrated regime, the probability remains limited even at larger circuit depths, reflecting the enhanced degeneracy and low‐energy competition induced by frustration. This behavior indicates that strongly frustrated, nearly degenerate regimes present a greater challenge for finite‐depth QAOA. Hardware‐oriented tests are also performed in the non‐frustrated regime, where ideal QAOA simulations reproduce the exact result. On a noisy simulator and IonQ quantum hardware, however, the probability decreases as the number of layers increases, showing that hardware noise still limits the achievable performance of deeper QAOA circuits.

papers.title: Post-selection games
papers.abstract: In this paper, we introduce post-selection games, a generalization of nonlocal games where each round can be not only won or lost by the players, but also discarded by the referee. Such games naturally formalize possibilistic proofs of nonlocality, such as Hardy's paradox. We develop algorithms for computing the local and Tsirelson bounds of post-selection games. Furthermore, we show that they have an unbounded advantage in statistical power over traditional nonlocal games, making them ideally suited for analysing Bell tests with low detection efficiency.

papers.title: Path to Quantum Simulations of Topological Phases: ( 2 + 1 ) D Quantum Electrodynamics with Wilson Fermions
papers.abstract: Quantum simulation offers a powerful approach to studying quantum field theories, particularly ( 2 + 1 ) D quantum electrodynamics ( QED 3 ) with Wilson fermions, which hosts a rich landscape of physical phenomena. A key challenge in lattice formulations is the proper realization of topological phases and the Chern-Simons terms, where fermion discretization plays a crucial role. In this Letter, we highlight the differences between staggered and Wilson fermions coupled to U(1) gauge fields in the Hamiltonian formulation. We analyze why staggered fermions fail to induce ( 2 + 1 ) D topological phases, while Wilson fermions admit a variety of topological phases including Chern insulator and quantum spin Hall phases. Additionally, we uncover a rich phase diagram for the two-flavor Wilson fermion model in the presence of a chemical potential. Our findings resolve existing ambiguities in Hamiltonian formulations and provide a theoretical foundation for future quantum simulations of lattice field theories with topological phases. We further outline connections to experimental platforms, offering guidance for implementations on near-term quantum computing architectures. A complementary presentation of the analytical calculations, the identification of robust topological structure and response, and extensive numerical results is contained in a joint submission [S. Bharadwaj , , 094502 (2026)].

Observation of Rabi-oscillation-driven cyclical noise squeezing in active quantum dot ensembles
papers.abstract: Squeezed light is usually generated using parametric processes in various nonlinear materials. Semiconductor lasers and optical amplifiers (SOAs) also offer nonlinearities, but they differ in that they add amplified spontaneous emission originating from population inversion, which represents a thermal state. Squeezing to below the vacuum level has been demonstrated in a semiconductor laser, and gain saturation in SOAs can likewise reduce field amplitude fluctuations to below the vacuum limit. Here, we demonstrate that Rabi oscillations in room-temperature quantum dot SOAs induced by short resonant pulses cause cyclical noise modification that repeats with every change of 2 π in pulse area. Homodyne measurements reveal in those cases elliptical Wigner functions corresponding to displaced squeezed thermal states and in some cases those corresponding to squeezing below the vacuum level. At other pulse areas, the Wigner functions are circular representing displaced thermal states. This periodic behavior persists over two orders of magnitude in input pulse energy. Under specific bias and excitation conditions, we further observe a non-Gaussian Wigner function featuring two bright lobes. Such a Wigner function does not represent any known quantum state. It resembles though a Schrödinger catlike non-Gaussian state, and we speculate that the accompanying negativity is suppressed due to an approximately 10 dB optical output loss. This speculation is confirmed by a simulation. Notably, the emergence of this non-Gaussian state is itself periodic in excitation pulse energy.

papers.title: Constraint-Preserving Quantum Error Mitigation by Projection onto Admissible Residual Spaces
papers.abstract: Quantum error mitigation (QEM) can improve target observables without ensuring that reconstructed experimental data satisfy known physical consistency conditions. We introduce a constraint-preserving QEM framework that represents reconstruction error in residual coordinates and projects the estimated residual onto the locally admissible tangent space defined by a differentiable physical constraint. The method removes the complete first-order constraint-violating component and suppresses generic constraint leakage to second order. We develop the construction analytically for CHSH correlations using no-signalling as the benchmark constraint and extend it to general smooth constraints. Deterministic and finite-shot simulations confirm the predicted suppression, including improved sampling behavior after projection. The method composes with calibrated readout mitigation and zero-noise extrapolation, while covariance-informed metrics provide optional task-dependent refinements. Real-device experiments on IBM quantum hardware validate the approach across eight disjoint physical qubit pairs and 24 pair-block realizations. After readout mitigation, projection reduces the no-signalling residual in all 24 realizations, with a mean paired reduction of 96.61% and negligible additional change in CHSH. A separate shot-count sweep improves all 15 hardware realizations, with a mean paired reduction of 97.38%, while revealing a hardware-limited residual floor at high shot count. Constraint-selectivity tests further show that different constraints remove different residual components. The method is entirely classical, requires no additional qubits, ancillas, or circuit depth, and provides a resource-efficient consistency layer for existing QEM pipelines.

papers.title: Adiabatic Preparation of a Fractional Quantum Hall Fluid by Coherently Pumping Atoms from a Bose-Einstein Condensate
papers.abstract: We propose a protocol to adiabatically prepare a many-particle fractional quantum Hall fluid of bosonic ultracold atoms exploiting a time-dependent coherent coupling of a strongly interacting atomic state with a large dilute Bose-Einstein condensate. Starting from an empty cloud, atoms with well-defined angular momentum are coherently pumped into the fluid by Raman beams with a Laguerre-Gauss profile. Compared to number-conserving schemes which rely on finite-size-induced gaps, we identify an adiabatic path in the Fock space which avoids crossing fixed-particle-number phase transitions and maintains a sizable and externally controlled adiabatic gap open at all times. The efficiency of our preparation protocol is numerically assessed for typical experimental parameters up to particle numbers that largely exceed the experimental state of the art. The crucial advantage of including an anharmonic confinement is finally highlighted.

Temporal Entanglement Transition in Chaotic Quantum Many-Body Dynamics
papers.abstract: Temporal entanglement (TE) of an influence matrix (IM) has been proposed as a measure of the complexity of simulating dynamics of local observables in many-body systems. Foligno recently argued that the TE in chaotic 1D quantum circuits obeys linear (volume law) scaling with evolution time. To reconcile this apparent high complexity of IM with the rapid thermalization of local observables, here we study the relation between TE, non-Markovianity, and local temporal correlations for chaotic quantum baths. By exactly solving a random-unitary bath model and bounding distillable entanglement between future and past degrees of freedom, we identify a regime where TE is extensive and reflects genuine non-Markovianity. This memory, however, is entirely contained in highly complex temporal correlations, and its effect on few-point temporal correlators is negligible. An IM coarse-graining procedure, reducing the allowed frequency of measurements of the probe system, results in a transition from volume- to subvolume- (area or logarithmic) law TE scaling. We demonstrate the generality of this TE transition in 1D circuits by analyzing the kicked Ising model analytically at dual-unitary points, as well as numerically away from them. This finding indicates that dynamics of local observables are fully captured by a subvolume-law IM. We provide evidence that the compact IM MPS obtained via standard compression algorithms accurately describes local evolution.

papers.title: Quantum machine learning for quantitative finance
papers.abstract: Machine learning (ML) and quantum ML (QML) have gained significant importance, as they offer powerful tools for tackling complex computational problems across various domains. An overview of QML’s uses in quantitative finance is presented here. The connection between quantum computing and ML in financial applications, spanning a range of use cases including portfolio optimization, market prediction and trading, pricing and risk management is examined. The different applications from the literature review are categorized based on specific use cases, ML approaches, optimization methods, and the types of quantum hardware utilized. To facilitate this examination, we employ a morphological box, which allows us to analyze different combinations of these elements across financial use cases.

papers.title: Nonlinear collective-spin dynamics for quantum-enhanced sensing in solid-state platforms
papers.abstract: Collective spin systems in solid-state materials are promising platforms for quantum-enhanced sensing. In systems such as nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond, donor spins in silicon, and magnetic materials, interactions among many spins can generate collective quantum correlations that improve measurement precision beyond the standard quantum limit. This tutorial develops an intuitive, materials-oriented framework for understanding these effects through nonlinear collective-spin dynamics. We show how nonlinear interactions reshape collective spin states in phase space, redistribute quantum fluctuations, and generate metrologically useful states such as spin-squeezed and entangled states. We then connect these ideal collective dynamics to microscopic interactions and realistic solid-state systems, discussing how interaction strength, disorder, decoherence, and experimental control affect sensing performance. Different platforms and experiments are compared to highlight key material properties, advantages, and limitations. The tutorial focuses on a materials-oriented understanding of nonlinear collective-spin sensing, rather than a comprehensive comparison of experimental platforms or a practical guide to sensing experiments.

papers.title: Long-range deformations in Gaussian states
papers.abstract: Imaginary-time evolution by a local Hamiltonian cannot induce a phase transition in one dimension, but longer-range interactions may subvert such constraints. Starting from the ground state of the Kitaev Majorana chain, we modify the wave function by an imaginary-time evolution generated by a quadratic Hamiltonian with power-law couplings that enhance pairing correlations, typically of the form 1 / r α , where r is the distance between two sites. As the state remains Gaussian, entanglement and correlation functions can be computed analytically. We find that the decay exponent α controls three distinct infrared regimes: for α > 1 , the deformation produces only smooth crossovers at finite deformation strength, while the topological regime is reached only asymptotically as the deformation strength tends to infinity. At α = 1 , the deformation induces an immediate flow to the topological phase: an infinitesimal deformation strength drives the system to a topological regime, and in a particular case, an emergent Kramers–Wannier symmetry enforces Ising-like scaling at long distances. For α < 1 , the deformed state shows the same critical-like behavior for all non-zero deformation strength. We observe that even with arbitrarily long-range interactions, these models do not display a sharp phase transition at non-zero deformation strength.

Distinguishing a Two-Step Quantum–Classical Threshold from Collapse Models
papers.abstract: A model of the vacuum as a face-centered-cubic lattice predicts a two-step quantum–classical threshold, at 13.1 and 22.6μg, from the hypothesis (P3) that a center-of-mass excitation stays coherently representable only while its reduced Compton wavelength is resolvable by the lattice. Collapse models also limit macroscopic coherence, so the two must be told apart by more than a scale. Taking P3 as a hypothesis, not a derived result, we derive discriminators from the model’s postulates and compute the counterpart in Diósi–Penrose collapse and in continuous spontaneous localization (CSL). The thresholds depend on total mass alone, the same for every material, while both collapse models depend on density. Below 13.1μg, the model predicts no intrinsic decoherence, where collapse takes 1 s for Diósi–Penrose and about a microsecond for CSL at its experimental bound, for 10−15 kg over 1μm; this also separates the model from energy-driven reduction models, which dephase at every mass. The model predicts no measurable heating. Two consistency requirements follow: read as position localization, its rate scale would exceed the LISA Pathfinder bound by 66 orders of magnitude, and read as strong energy-basis dephasing it would destroy the phase of classical oscillations of macroscopic bodies. The Compton-scale correction does not alter the motion of microgram bodies. If the effective mass of a mechanical mode is the relevant mass, a mechanical cat state quoted at 16.2μg bounds the irreversible coupling at 37 orders below its natural scale; in another common convention, that mode is below the threshold. A worked levitated-particle example, an outlook for near-future data, and a public script complete the analysis.

Second Law of Thermodynamics in Closed Quantum Many-Body Systems
papers.abstract: The second law of thermodynamics for adiabatic operations—constraints on state transitions in closed systems under external control—is one of the fundamental principles of thermodynamics. On the other hand, recent studies of thermalization have established that even pure quantum states can represent thermal equilibrium. However, pure quantum states do not satisfy the second law in that they are not passive, i.e., work can be extracted from them if arbitrary unitary operations are allowed, and that various entropy formulas, such as the von Neumann entropy, deviate from thermodynamic entropy in such states. It therefore remains unresolved how thermal equilibrium represented by a pure quantum state can be reconciled with thermodynamics. Here, based on our key quantum-mechanical notions of thermal equilibrium and adiabatic operations, we address the emergence of the second law of thermodynamics in closed quantum many-body systems. We first introduce infinite-observable macroscopic thermal equilibrium (iMATE): a quantum state, including pure states, is said to represent iMATE if the expectation values of additive observables, which correspond to additive quantities in thermodynamics, agree with their equilibrium values. We also introduce a macroscopic operation as unitary evolution generated by a additive Hamiltonian, which is regarded as corresponding to adiabatic operations. Employing these concepts, we show Planck’s principle: no extensive work can be extracted from any quantum state representing iMATE through any cyclic macroscopic operations with the operation times independent of the system size. Furthermore, we introduce a quantum-mechanical form of entropy density such that it agrees with thermodynamic entropy density for any quantum state representing iMATE. We then prove the law of increasing entropy: for any initial state representing iMATE, this entropy density cannot be decreased by any macroscopic operations with the operation times independent of the system size, followed by a relaxation process governed by a time-independent Hamiltonian. Our theory thus proves two different forms of the second law, which are quantum mechanically inequivalent to each other, and demonstrates how thermodynamics emerges from quantum mechanics by adopting macroscopically reasonable classes of observables, equilibrium states, and operations.

QwaveMPS: An efficient open-source Python package for simulating non-Markovian waveguide-QED using matrix product states
papers.abstract: QwaveMPS is an open-source Python library for simulating one-dimensional quantum many-body waveguide systems using matrix product states (MPS). It provides a user-friendly interface for constructing, evolving, and analyzing quantum states and operators, facilitating studies in quantum physics and quantum information with waveguide-QED systems. This approach enables efficient, scalable simulations by focusing computational resources on the most relevant parts of the quantum system. Thus, one can study a wide range of complex dynamical interactions, including time-delayed feedback effects in the non-Markovian regime and deeply nonlinear systems, at a highly reduced computational cost compared to full Hilbert space approaches, making it both practical and convenient to model a variety of open waveguide-QED systems (in Markovian and non-Markovian regimes), treating quantized atoms and quantized photons on an equal footing. The QwaveMPS package automates the waveguide-QED-specific tensor-network operations, including construction of the time-bin evolution operator from physical parameters, the swap network required for delayed interactions, orthogonality-center and truncation management, the matrix-product factorization of N -photon Fock-state inputs, and the evaluation of single-time and two-time field observables (such as the second-order quantum correlation function) at chosen points along the waveguide.

Finite-Size Scaling Theory of Rényi Thermal Entropy for Second-Order, First-Order, and Weakly First-Order Quantum Phase Transitions
papers.abstract: Establishing the nature of a quantum phase transition in finite-size simulations—whether continuous, first order, or weakly first order—is a fundamental challenge in quantum many-body computation. The weakly first-order transition is particularly elusive: its anomalously large correlation length invariably mimics a continuous critical point at accessible system sizes, and no unified finite-size scaling theory has existed to distinguish these scenarios under realistic computational constraints. In this work, we address this problem by introducing a finite-size scaling framework based on the Rényi thermal entropy (RTE) and its derivative (DRTE). We derive the finite-size scaling forms for the RTE and DRTE at continuous, first-order, and weakly first-order quantum phase transitions and show that the DRTE isolates the universal contribution of the free energy and strengthens the characteristics of various phase transitions in finite sizes. Using quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we demonstrate accurate data collapse and extraction of critical exponents at ( 2 + 1 )-dimensional O ( N ) critical points. Most importantly, the DRTE provides a definitive signature of weakly first-order transitions at visitable sizes—a zero crossing and a double-peak structure—which we observe in the debated deconfined quantum criticality candidates such as the J − Q and SU(8) J 1 − J 2 models. Our approach offers a general, order-parameter-agnostic, and numerically efficient diagnostic tool, resolving long-standing ambiguities between continuous and weakly first-order scenarios in the finite-size simulations.

papers.abstract: While classical convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have revolutionized image classification, the emergence of quantum CNNs (QCNNs) presents new opportunities with high-dimensional transformations that are infeasible for classical CNNs. However, their implementation on current noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) devices remains challenging due to hardware limitations. In our research, we address this challenge by introducing fragment encoding that significantly reduces the input dimensionality. We show that accuracy improves as the number of qubits increases from 1 to 4 to 16, providing evidence of favorable scaling. Motivated by this, we developed a primitive QCNN architecture with $$\varvec{49}$$ qubits which is sufficient to directly process $$\varvec{28 \times 28}$$ pixel MNIST images, eliminating the need for classical dimensionality reduction pre-processing. Additionally, we propose an automated framework based on expressibility, entanglement, and complexity characteristics to identify the building blocks of QCNNs, parameterized quantum circuits (PQCs). Our approach demonstrates advantages in convergence speed with a similar parameter count compared to both LM-QCNNs and classical CNNs. We validated our experiments on IBM’s Heron r2 quantum processor, achieving $$\varvec{96.08\%}$$ accuracy with approximately $$\varvec{70\%}$$ faster convergence relative to classical CNNs under identical training conditions. Our results show that simple image-classification tasks can be realized on real quantum hardware today.

A Four-Dimensional Toric Code on the D4 Lattice: [[16L4,6,2L2]] with Weight-4 X-Stabilizers
papers.abstract: We study a four-dimensional toric code on the D4 lattice, the densest four-dimensional lattice packing. Qubits sit on the 16L4 triangles of its Delaunay decomposition into regular 16-cells. Each X-stabilizer acts on the four triangles of a tetrahedron, the smallest possible weight, and each Z-stabilizer on the eight triangles meeting along an edge. Up to exchanging X and Z, this is the face code of the dual 24-cell honeycomb, which has been proposed before without its parameters. We prove that the code is [[16L4,6,2L2]] for every even L≥4, with dX=2L2 and dZ=4L2 exactly. A logical operator must cast a shadow covering a two-dimensional cross-section of the torus, and a single triangle shadows an area of at most 1/2; explicit operators built from flat planes attain the resulting bounds in both sectors. The code reaches distance d with 4d2 qubits against 6d2 for the standard hypercubic code, although rotated hypercubic codes need fewer. Hook errors from the weight-8 checks cost no more than those from the weight-4 checks. Excitations in both sectors are loops, and the slices of the lattice are face-centered cubic. Published scripts verify all results.
